A natural fix is to make the selection signal one that cannot be computed without the image. We study Perturbation Grounded Selection (Pgs), a label-free, training-free rule that scores each candidate by whether the model re-derives it under label-preserving perturbations of the input (cropping, background masking, mild photometric or geometric jitter); Pgs recovers majority voting when the perturbation set is empty. The decisive question is not whether Pgs beats chain-of-thought only majority voting, but whether the perturbation term adds anything once decoding format and budget are controlled. We therefore introduce a format-matched control (MatchedCtrl): the same short, no-CoT draws spent on the original image. Across TextVQA, MATH-Vision, MMMU, and ViLP, with a Qwen headline (three-seed means) and LLaVA-OneVision coverage in matched-budget selector tables, Pgs appears to beat plain majority voting by up to +31.8 points on TextVQA (Qwen), but MatchedCtrl tracks or exceeds Pgs within noise on every benchmark, including the vision-required ViLP; no Qwen category shows a significant gain over this control. The stability gap is real and image-dependent (up to +0.48), yet does not predict per-instance wins. The result is negative and diagnostic: perturbation consistency is at best a partial diagnostic of visual dependence and, on its own, not a usable selection signal once format is controlled; gains reported against CoT-only majority voting overstate such methods.

</details>


### [117] [VaRS-Doc: Interpretation-Aware Variant Representations via Latent Self-Probing for Visual Document Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01211)
*Haocheng Wang,Tongkun Guan,Wei Shen,Xiaokang Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了VaRS-Doc，一种视觉文档检索框架，通过在文档编码阶段主动探索多种潜在语义解释来多样化文档表示，同时保留高效的晚期交互检索机制，让每个查询自适应地选择最匹配的表示，解决了查询无关文档编码与查询特定检索需求之间的不匹配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有晚期交互架构要求文档在查询之前被编码为固定表示，但同一视觉文档内容在不同查询意图下可能产生不同解释，固定表示难以捕捉这种多样性；而延迟编码又会带来不可接受的在线检索延迟。

Method: 提出VaRS-Doc框架，在文档编码阶段使模型主动探索变体潜在解释以多样化文档表示，同时保持晚期交互检索范式（查询自适应选择最优表示）；引入两阶段训练策略，鼓励模型捕捉互补的语义解释并防止退化为单一主导表示。

Result: 在视觉文档检索基准上达到最先进的检索性能，代码已开源。

Conclusion: VaRS-Doc为查询感知的视觉文档检索提供了一种实用解决方案，在不牺牲检索效率的前提下弥合了查询无关文档编码与查询特定检索需求之间的差距。

Abstract: Visual document retrieval has recently become increasingly important in applications such as enterprise search, scientific literature discovery, and retrieval-augmented generation. These applications depend on efficiently identifying query-relevant pages across large collections of visually rich documents. Existing methods commonly adopt late-interaction architectures that encode and index documents offline to enable scalable and low-latency online retrieval. Despite its efficiency, this paradigm requires each document to be encoded into a fixed representation before the query is known. However, the same content in a visual document may induce different interpretations depending on the query intent, which a fixed representation struggles to capture. Yet postponing document encoding until the query arrives would incur prohibitive online retrieval latency. To address this gap, we propose VaRS-Doc, a visual document retrieval framework that diversifies document representations by enabling the model to actively explore variant latent interpretations during document encoding, while preserving efficient late-interaction retrieval in which each query adaptively selects the best-fit representation. We further introduce a two-stage training strategy that encourages the model to capture complementary semantic interpretations and prevents it from falling back to train a single dominant representation. Experiments on visual document retrieval benchmarks show that VaRS-Doc achieves state-of-the-art retrieval performance, offering a practical solution to the mismatch between query-agnostic document encoding and query-specific retrieval needs. Code is available at https://github.com/bokufa/VaRS-Doc.

</details>


### [118] [From Forest to Future Capital: Tracking Land Cover Change in Ibu Kota Nusantara (IKN) from 2021 to 2026 with PlanetScope Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01230)
*Clarissa Rui Min Ong,Elizabeth Tee Inn Loo,Kenneth Woon Hao Soh,William Rachmadi,Qiming Zheng,Hao Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究利用PlanetScope SuperDove卫星影像和遥感技术，对印尼新首都努山塔拉（IKN）核心政府区（KIPP）2021至2026年的土地利用与植被变化进行了系统评估。结果显示NDVI均值下降17.1%，碳储量减少0.28%，开发用地扩张672%，植被总量下降18.1%。遥感方法有效监测了大型城市开发的环境影响，但未来需更高分辨率、高光谱和SAR方法以提升建筑阶段与种植园变化的检测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 印尼将首都从雅加达迁至努山塔拉（IKN）并宣传"森林城市"愿景，但核心政府区（KIPP）的快速建设引发了关于土地转换、植被丧失和碳储量下降的严重担忧。作者希望通过遥感技术系统量化评估这一大规模城市开发对生态环境的实际影响。

Method: 使用PlanetScope SuperDove卫星影像（2021-2026年），制备无云镶嵌影像后，通过光谱指数（NDVI、NDRE、NDWI）并结合支持向量机（SVM）监督分类方法进行土地利用/土地覆盖（LULC）分类分析。通过对比不同年份的植被指数变化和土地覆盖分类结果，评估研究期间的环境变化趋势。

Result: 研究期间环境发生显著转变：平均NDVI下降17.1%，总碳储量下降0.28%，开发用地扩张672%，总植被减少18.1%。植被丧失最严重时期为2023-2024年，但2024-2025年出现NDVI和碳储量的暂时恢复，原因是清理活动放缓且开发转向已清理土地。

Conclusion: 遥感技术为监测大型城市开发的环境影响提供了有效手段，但当前方法仍有局限，未来需结合更高分辨率的影像、高光谱数据和SAR技术，以更精确地检测建筑施工阶段和种植园相关的土地覆盖变化。

Abstract: Indonesia's relocation of its political and administrative capital from Jakarta to Ibu Kota Nusantara (IKN) has been framed around a ``Forest City'' vision, yet rapid construction within the Core Government Area (KIPP) raises concerns over land conversion, vegetation loss, and carbon stock decline. This study applies remote sensing techniques to systematically assess land use and vegetation cover change in KIPP from 2021 to 2026 using PlanetScope SuperDove satellite imagery. Cloud-free mosaics were prepared and analysed through spectral indices, including the Normalised Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), Normalised Difference Red Edge (NDRE), and Normalised Difference Water Index (NDWI), alongside supervised land use and land cover (LULC) classification using a Support Vector Machine algorithm. Results show substantial environmental transformation, with mean NDVI declined by 17.1\%, total carbon stock decreased by 0.28\%, developed land expanded by 672\%, and total vegetation declined by 18.1\%. Vegetation loss was most extensive between 2023 and 2024, although a temporary recovery in NDVI and carbon stock occurred from 2024 to 2025 as active clearing slowed and development shifted towards already-cleared land. Overall, the findings demonstrate that remote sensing provides an effective approach for monitoring the environmental impacts of large-scale urban development, while highlighting the need for higher-resolution, hyperspectral, and SAR-based methods to improve detection of construction stages and plantation-related land cover changes.

</details>


### [119] [A Benchmark Dataset for MLLM-Generated Image Detection: GPT Image2 & Nano Banana2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01258)
*Zirui Zhang,Yinbo Yu,Donghai Guan,Chunwei Tian,Daoqiang Zhang,Qi Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个面向多模态大语言模型(MLLM)生成图像检测的基准数据集，覆盖多种真实应用场景和三种生成协议，并提出结构伪影先验引导的双流提示框架(SAP-DSP)作为强基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前MLLM(如GPT Image2、Nano Banana2)生成的图像质量大幅提升，尤其在文本渲染方面取得了明显进步，对AI生成图像检测构成了日益严峻的挑战。然而现有检测基准大多基于早期生成模型构建，无法充分评估高质量、多形态生成图像所带来的取证难题。

Method: 构建了一个覆盖多种真实应用场景的基准数据集，采用三种生成协议模拟直接生成、基于参考的重建和局部编辑。在此基础上，提出结构伪影先验引导的双流提示框架(SAP-DSP)，利用双流提示学习和结构感知路由融合来增强表征学习。

Result: 实验表明所提出的基准暴露了现有检测器在高质量生成图像上的性能退化问题，而SAP-DSP在该基准上取得了更稳定的检测结果。

Conclusion: 当前检测方法在MLLM生成的高质量图像上存在明显的性能下降，需要一个系统性的新基准来评估新一代生成内容的检测能力，SAP-DSP为该基准提供了一个有效的强基线。

Abstract: The realism of images generated by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), such as GPT Image2 and Nano Banana2, has improved rapidly in recent years. Compared with early generative models, current models have made clear progress in text rendering. They can produce high-quality images that closely resemble real-world application scenarios. The enhanced generation capabilities of current MLLMs pose increasingly severe challenges to AI-generated image detection. Detection is no longer limited to identifying obvious artifacts left by early generators. Instead, it requires systematic and realistic benchmarks for the new generation of generated content. However, most existing benchmarks are still built around early generative models and cannot fully evaluate the forensic challenges introduced by high-quality and multi-form generated images. To address this gap, this paper constructs a benchmark dataset for detecting images generated by MLLMs. The benchmark covers several realistic application scenarios and adopts three generation protocols to simulate direct generation, reference-based reconstruction, and local editing. Based on this benchmark, we evaluate detector degradation from traditional scenarios to MLLM-generated images and analyze false positive rates and false negative rates across three sample types, revealing the failure modes of existing methods. We further propose a structural-artifact-prior-guided dual-stream prompt framework (SAP-DSP) as a strong baseline. SAP-DSP uses dual-stream prompt learning and structure-aware routing fusion to improve representation learning. Extensive experiments show that the proposed benchmark exposes the performance degradation of existing detectors on high-quality generated images, while SAP-DSP achieves more stable detection results on this benchmark. Our code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/xbrainnet/SAP-DSP.

</details>


### [120] [Rethinking Video Token Compression with a Global Codebook: Learning Once, Compressing Everywhere](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01271)
*Jiayang He,Tianling Xu,Diancheng Kang,Huaide Jiang,Junyan Bai,Shaoming Zheng,Xuan Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ONCE框架，一种离线到在线的视频token压缩范式，通过预先学习的频率感知全局码本实现轻量级在线压缩，在保持竞争性性能的同时实现最低推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Video-LLMs将视频表示为密集的视觉token序列，其长度随输入时空范围增长，且包含大量冗余。已有的在线压缩方法（剪枝、合并）在推理时为每个输入视频反复引入额外计算开销，且常依赖特定模型设计，限制了通用性。因此需要一种将昂贵的压缩过程转移到离线的范式。

Method: 提出ONCE（Offline-to-online Compression framework），一种即插即用的视频token压缩框架。核心创新是离线到在线（offline-to-online）范式：在视觉特征空间中预先学习一个频率感知的全局码本（frequency-aware global codebook），推理时通过码本查找（codebook lookup）和聚合（aggregation）实现轻量级在线压缩，从而避免每个视频重复的计算开销，也无需针对特定模型进行压缩设计。

Result: 在多个视频理解基准和多种压缩基线上的大量实验表明，该方法在准确率与效率之间取得了良好的平衡，在保持竞争性性能的同时，在对比方法中实现了最低的推理延迟。

Conclusion: 离线到在线的压缩范式是可行的，通过一次性学习码本可以显著降低在线推理时的计算开销，同时不牺牲准确性，为视频token压缩提供了一个更具通用性和高效性的新方向。

Abstract: Video large language models (Video-LLMs) represent videos as dense sequences of visual tokens, whose length grows with the temporal and spatial extent of the input. These tokens often contain substantial redundancy arising from repeated visual patterns, leading to unnecessary computation in the subsequent language-model processing. Existing token compression methods, including pruning and merging, perform compression online during inference, repeatedly incurring additional computation for each input video and often relying on model-specific designs that limit their generality, we instead rethink this paradigm by shifting the costly compression process offline. We propose \textbf{ONCE}, a plug-in video token compression framework that introduces an offline-to-online paradigm: a frequency-aware global codebook is learned once in the visual feature space and reused for lightweight online compression through codebook lookup and aggregation, reducing repeated per-video computation and the need for model-specific compression designs. Extensive experiments across multiple video understanding benchmarks and against diverse compression baselines demonstrate that our approach achieves a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off, maintaining competitive performance while achieving the lowest inference latency among compared methods.

</details>


### [121] [Astrolabe: Spherical-Map Guidance Across Diffusion Pipelines for Full-Body Capture from Unconstrained Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01276)
*Shuliang Zhu,Qi Wang,Ryugo Morita,Jinjia Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Astrolabe，一个宿主可移植的适配器，利用冻结的视角引导球面图（SPH）通过空间噪声位移来组织扩散先验的适应与引导，实现从非约束照片进行全身捕捉，无需密集匹配或学习的控制分支。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从非约束照片进行全身捕捉需要跨任意视角、姿态、裁剪和遮挡的全局对应关系，但在这种设定下估计的姿态、几何和基础特征过于不可靠，无法用于密集匹配或外观转移。同时，扩散修正器和优化管线没有统一接口来消费这种不确定的对应关系。现有方法缺乏一种能组织扩散先验适应与引导的粗粒度对应机制。

Method: Astrolabe的核心洞察是：对应关系无需局部精确，其粗粒度视角和身体布局仍可组织扩散先验的适应并引导重建。该方法构建在冻结的视角引导球面图（SPH）上：一个固定的有界变换将SPH转换为空间噪声位移，在先验适应期间进行匹配，并在下游去噪或分数蒸馏引导中复用。当修正器暴露参考路由器时，利用相同的目标/参考SPH提供粗粒度兼容性分数来选择原生外观特征；无路由的优化仅使用共享的位移路径。整个过程遵循SPH→位移→适应→引导的单一流程，无需密集扭曲或学习控制分支。

Result: 在Puzzle-IOI和4D-Dress数据集上，Astrolabe在两个宿主中改进了所有报告的图像指标以及所有配对的Puzzle-IOI几何指标；图像增益延伸到后视图，同时4D-Dress的几何指标整体保持稳定。

Conclusion: Astrolabe证明了一种基于SPH到空间噪声位移的统一适配机制可以有效地跨不同扩散管线（修正器和优化）工作，通过粗粒度对应关系组织先验适应，在不破坏几何稳定性的前提下提升重建质量，尤其在图像指标上表现显著，包括更具挑战性的后视图。

Abstract: Full-body capture from unconstrained photographs requires global correspondence across arbitrary views, poses, crops, and occlusions. Yet pose, geometry, and foundation features estimated in this setting are too unreliable for dense matching or appearance transfer, while diffusion rectifiers and optimization pipelines expose no common interface for consuming such uncertain correspondence. Our insight is that correspondence need not be locally accurate: its coarse viewpoint and body layout can still organize how a diffusion prior adapts and guides reconstruction. We introduce \emph{Astrolabe}, a host-portable adapter built on frozen viewpoint-guided spherical maps (SPH). A fixed bounded transform converts SPH into a spatial noise shift, which is matched during prior adaptation and reused during downstream denoising or score-distillation guidance in both pipeline categories. When a rectifier exposes a reference router, the same target/reference SPH additionally supplies coarse compatibility scores to select native appearance features; router-free optimization uses only the shared shift path. Astrolabe therefore follows one SPH--shift--adapt--guide process without dense warping or a learned control branch. Across Puzzle-IOI and 4D-Dress, it improves all reported image metrics in both hosts and all paired Puzzle-IOI geometry metrics; image gains extend to rear views, while 4D-Dress geometry remains stable overall.

</details>


### [122] [TurboClear: One-Step Object-Effect Removal via Region-Calibrated Distribution Matching and Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01288)
*Jiawei Guo,Junxian Li,Yixin Tang,Bingya Zhang,Jiaxin Lu,Yulun Zhang,Shangchen Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TurboClear 是一个基于 SDXL 的单步对象-效果移除模型，通过区域校准分布匹配（RDM）和可学习空间融合（LSF）实现了高达40.04倍（对比ObjectClear）和665倍（对比OmniPaint）的推理加速，同时保持可比的视觉移除质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于扩散的移除方法虽然视觉质量好，但依赖多步去噪导致推理成本高。直接应用现有单步蒸馏方法效果不佳，因为其全局目标缺乏显式的区域级校准，无法保持对象-效果移除所需的非对称"编辑-保留"行为。

Method: 提出TurboClear，一个单步SDXL对象-效果移除模型。训练阶段设计了区域校准分布匹配（Region-Calibrated Distribution Matching, RDM）用于区域感知蒸馏，以保留教师模型的非对称编辑-保留行为；推理阶段提出可学习空间融合（Learnable Spatial Fusion, LSF）用于轻量级融合。

Result: TurboClear在显著提升推理效率的同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量：计算开销相比ObjectClear减少高达40.04倍，相比基于Flux的OmniPaint减少高达665倍，且视觉移除质量可比或更优。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 通过区域感知的蒸馏策略和学习式空间融合，成功将多步扩散移除模型压缩为单步推理，在不牺牲视觉质量的前提下实现数量级的推理加速，验证了区域校准对非对称编辑-保留任务蒸馏的有效性。

Abstract: Recently, diffusion-based removal methods have achieved promising visual quality in removing both target objects and their associated effects. However, they typically rely on multi-step denoising, leading to high inference cost. Directly applying existing one-step distillation methods is also suboptimal, since their global objectives lack explicit region-wise calibration and may weaken the asymmetric edit-and-preserve behavior required by object-effect removal. To address these challenges, we propose TurboClear, a one-step SDXL-based object-effect removal model. During training, we design Region-Calibrated Distribution Matching (RDM) for region-aware distillation to preserve the teacher model's asymmetric edit-and-preserve behavior. Furthermore, we propose Learnable Spatial Fusion (LSF) for lightweight inference-time fusion. Extensive experiments show that TurboClear significantly improves inference efficiency while maintaining competitive visual quality. TurboClear reduces the computational overhead by up to $40.04\times$ compared to ObjectClear, and by up to $665\times$ against the Flux-based method OmniPaint, all while maintaining comparable or better visual removal quality. Code is available at https://github.com/GuoCalix/TurboClear.

</details>


### [123] [UDT: Reconciling U-Nets and Diffusion Transformers with Data-Adaptive Token Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01298)
*Junno Yun,Yaşar Utku Alçalar,Mehmet Akçakaya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出UDT，一种融合DiT表示能力与U-Net编码-解码优势的U-Net扩散Transformer，通过数据自适应的token合并实现上下采样，在保持DiT token维度的同时实现更优的收敛速度和生成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiTs在各向同性transformer块中逐层渐进学习表示，去噪目标促使后期层专注细粒度重建，导致表示质量退化及编码器-解码器行为失衡。现有方法如REPA通过训练正则化增强早期表示，U-Net风格DiT虽引入多尺度结构但使用可学习算子进行空间下采样，与transformer架构不兼容，带来效率和兼容性问题。

Method: 提出UDT架构，通过数据自适应的token合并实现下采样和上采样，在保留DiT token维度的同时引入U-Net的多尺度编码-解码结构。该方法无需可学习空间下采样算子，与cross-attention和表示正则化等组件良好兼容。

Result: UDT基线架构优于现有U-Net DiTs，性能与REPA相当。结合架构优化和REPA后，在256x256 ImageNet上XL模型40个epoch达到SiT 1400个epoch的7.9 FID性能（约40倍收敛加速）。使用CFG时达到FID 1.38（SD-VAE，320 epochs）和1.35（VA-VAE，500 epochs）。

Conclusion: UDT为DiTs提供了一种新的骨干架构，通过数据自适应token合并有效融合U-Net编码-解码优势与DiT的表示能力，在收敛速度和生成质量上均取得显著提升，具有强大的实证效益。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have emerged as a core architecture in generative modeling due to their scalability and adaptability to multimodal tasks. DiTs comprise isotropic transformer blocks, and learn representations progressively across depth, where the denoising objective drives later layers to focus on fine-detail reconstruction. This results in degraded representation quality and an imbalanced encoder-decoder behavior. Prior approaches such as representation alignment (REPA) mitigate this by encouraging stronger early representations via training regularization. Alternatively, U-Net-style DiT architectures introduce explicit multi-scale encoder-decoder structures for improved convergence. But they build on standard U-Net wisdom via learnable operators for spatial downsampling, which are not well-suited to transformer architectures, introducing inefficiencies and compatibility issues with components such as cross-attention and representation regularization. In this work, we propose UDT, a U-Net diffusion transformer that combines the representation power of DiTs with the encoding-decoding benefits of U-Nets, through data-adaptive token merging for downsampling and upsampling, while preserving the DiT token dimension. Our baseline UDT architecture outperforms existing U-Net DiTs and achieves performance comparable to REPA across all model sizes. Furthermore, using architectural optimization and REPA, UDT outperforms SiT's 7.9 FID at 1400 epochs (w/o CFG) within 40 epochs (~ 40x faster convergence) for XL model size on 256x256 ImageNet. Finally, it achieves strong image generation performance with CFG, reaching FID of 1.38 (320 epochs) with SD-VAE and 1.35 (500 epochs) with VA-VAE, providing a new backbone for DiTs with strong empirical benefits.

</details>


### [124] [Ranking Image Fusion the Way Humans Do: A Learned Pairwise Preference Metric for Infrared-Visible Fusion Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01301)
*Haoran Liu,Mingzhe Liu,Peng Li,Guibin Zan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LPIFM（Learned Perceptual Image Fusion Measure），一种源条件模型，通过模拟人类A/B/平局的成对比较协议来评估红外-可见光图像融合（IVIF）质量。该模型联合观察红外源、可见光源及两个融合候选结果，预测哪个更优或两者感知等价。模型由一个大规模稠密偏好语料库监督训练，该语料库覆盖公开基准场景上广泛融合方法的全部无序比较对，并采用盲化、随机化的两阶段标注协议加专家仲裁。实验表明LPIFM在场景泛化和方法泛化设置下均能紧密跟踪人类成对决策，并再现基于平局的Bradley-Terry排序；在全方法池上，其成对准确率和排序相关性大幅超越最强传统指标。作者同时发布了标注偏好数据集、模型权重、源代码和评估代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 红外-可见光图像融合（IVIF）缺乏理想融合参考，现有客观标量指标（如信息传递、结构或源相似性代理）常与人类主观偏好不一致，而直接进行成对比较虽是最可靠的主观评估方案，但其成本随算法数量呈平方级增长，无法常规使用。因此需要一种可扩展、可重复且与人类判断对齐的替代评估方法。

Method: LPIFM是一种源条件的深度学习模型，输入为红外源、可见光源及两个融合候选（共四张图像），输出三分类概率：候选A更优、候选B更优、或感知等价。训练数据来自新构建的稠密偏好语料库，覆盖公共基准场景上大量融合方法的所有无序成对比较，标注流程采用盲化、随机化的两阶段协议并引入专家仲裁以保障标签质量。评估上，LPIFM在场景泛化与方法泛化设置下进行测试，并使用成对准确率和与人类Bradley-Terry排序的相关性作为衡量标准。

Result: 在场景泛化和方法泛化两种设置下，LPIFM的成对判断与人类专家决策高度吻合，并能复现由人类标签导出的偏好感知（tie-aware）Bradley-Terry排序。在完整方法池上，LPIFM在成对准确率和排序相关性两方面均以较大优势超过现有最强的传统客观指标。

Conclusion: LPIFM提供了一种可扩展、可重复且与人类偏好对齐的IVIF评估工具，支持在规模上对融合方法进行人类对齐的比较与排名。作者公开了标注偏好数据集、模型权重、源代码及评估代码，以推动偏好对齐的IVIF评估研究。

Abstract: Infrared-visible image fusion (IVIF) has no ideal fused reference, so fusion algorithms are routinely ranked by scalar objective metrics that formalize different proxies for information transfer, structure, or source similarity. These proxies often disagree with the judgment that ultimately matters: given the same sources, which of two fused results does a human prefer? Direct pairwise comparison is an established reference protocol for relative subjective assessment, but its cost grows quadratically with the number of algorithms, which prevents routine use. We present the Learned Perceptual Image Fusion Measure (LPIFM), a source-conditioned model that operationalizes the human A/B/Tie comparison protocol as a repeatable, scalable surrogate. LPIFM jointly observes the infrared source, the visible source, and two fused candidates, and predicts whether candidate A is better, candidate B is better, or the two are perceptually equivalent. Supervision comes from a new dense preference corpus that covers every unordered comparison among a broad pool of fusion methods on the scenes of a public benchmark, labeled under a blinded, randomized, two-stage protocol with expert adjudication. Across scene- and method-generalization settings, LPIFM tracks human pairwise decisions closely and reproduces the tie-aware Bradley-Terry rankings derived from human labels; on full method pools it surpasses the strongest conventional metric by a wide margin in both pairwise accuracy and ranking correlation. We release the annotated preference dataset, together with the LPIFM model weights, source code, and evaluation code, to support preference-aligned IVIF assessment. LPIFM offers a practical instrument for human-aligned method comparison and ranking at scale.

</details>


### [125] [Beyond Symmetric Fusion: Exploiting Task-Dependent Modality Strengths for RGB-Event Small Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01302)
*Ziheng Wang,Chaolang Li,Yutong Yang,Xiaohan Xu,Chongxiang Yang,Hengxuan Zhong,Zhen Liang,Pengwen Dai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出AERODet，一种非对称的RGB-Event目标检测Transformer。通过模态特异性评估发现Event数据更适合类无关定位而RGB数据更适合分类，因此设计SURE模块在定位阶段根据目标性响应热图自适应校准双模态贡献，并在分类阶段用TDSR模块解耦分类与定位，仅使用RGB RoI特征进行细粒度分类。在FRED和NeRDD上达到SOTA，FRED挑战性分割上超越最强基线10.7 mAP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RGB-Event检测器通常将两种模态融合成统一表示同时用于定位和分类，这种任务对称的设计与直觉相矛盾——两种模态应根据各自的任务优势发挥不同作用。作者通过模态特异性评估发现，两种模态的相对优势在不同任务上发生逆转：Event数据对类无关定位更有效，RGB数据对局部区域内的分类更有效。

Method: 提出AERODet（非对称Event-RGB目标检测Transformer），包含两个关键模块：1）SURE（Scale-wise Uncertainty-aware Reliability Estimation）：在类无关定位阶段，从两种模态的目标性响应热图中计算相对可靠性，并在解码器聚合多模态特征时据此校准各自贡献；2）TDSR（Task-Decoupled Semantic Refinement）：在获得候选框后，将分类与定位解耦，使用RGB RoI特征进行细粒度分类。

Result: 在FRED和NeRDD数据集上进行了广泛实验，AERODet达到最先进性能。在FRED挑战性分割（challenging split）上，超越最强RGB-Event基线10.7个mAP点。

Conclusion: 通过实证发现两种模态在不同子任务上的相对优势具有逆转性，据此设计任务非对称的多模态融合机制可显著提升RGB-Event目标检测性能，验证了任务感知的非对称设计比任务对称的统一融合更优。

Abstract: State-of-the-art RGB-Event detectors improve the detection of small, fast-moving objects by combining complementary features from RGB and Event data, yet they typically fuse the two modalities into a unified representation for both localization and classification. Such a task-symmetric design is inconsistent with the intuition that the two modalities should play different roles according to their task-specific strengths. To examine this issue, we conduct a modality-specific evaluation and find that the relative advantage of the two modalities reverses across tasks: Event data are substantially more effective for class-agnostic localization, whereas RGB data provide stronger category evidence within localized target regions. Motivated by this task-dependent asymmetry, we propose an Asymmetric Event-RGB Object Detection Transformer (AERODet). During class-agnostic localization, Scale-wise Uncertainty-aware Reliability Estimation (SURE) calculates the relative reliability of the two modalities from their objectness response heatmaps and accordingly calibrates their contributions when the decoder aggregates multimodal features. Once the candidate boxes are obtained, Task-Decoupled Semantic Refinement (TDSR) decouples classification from localization and uses RGB RoI features for fine-grained classification. Extensive experiments on FRED and NeRDD demonstrate that AERODet achieves state-of-the-art performance. In particular, it surpasses the strongest RGB-Event baseline by 10.7 mAP points on the FRED challenging split.

</details>


### [126] [SPAE: Spectrally Guided Autoencoder for Pretrained Visual Latents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01306)
*Yibin Huang,Jixiang Hong,Zongzhao Li,Yuhan Dai,Zhibin Wang,Chunwei Wang,Jun Song,Chen Wang,Xiaofei Sun,Xiaoxiao Xu,Conghui Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SPAE是一个针对视觉基础模型潜在空间的生成适配框架，通过紧凑瓶颈提取稳定语义信息并抑制高频分量，同时采用通道级掩码策略促进语义与高频细节的解耦，使DiT生成与编码器潜在空间更好对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉基础模型（VFM）的潜在表示语义丰富且适合视觉理解，但直接用于图像生成时，DiT生成的潜在表示与编码器潜在表示存在频谱不匹配，尤其是高频分量。进一步分析发现高频分量在潜在通道中弥散分布且与语义信息纠缠，导致潜在空间难以被DiT直接建模。

Method: SPAE框架包含两个关键设计：(1) 紧凑瓶颈（compact bottleneck）用于蒸馏稳定的语义信息同时抑制高频分量，改善DiT生成潜在与编码器潜在的对齐；(2) 通道级掩码策略（channel-wise masking）促进语义信息与高频细节在瓶颈通道间的解耦。

Result: 实验表明SPAE在视觉理解、生成质量和重建保真度之间取得了良好的平衡，通过频谱分析与通道级策略有效解决了VFM潜在空间的建模难题。

Conclusion: SPAE证明了通过对VFM潜在空间进行适配（包括语义蒸馏与高频抑制）可以有效弥合自编码器潜在空间与DiT生成潜在空间之间的频谱差异，实现理解与生成的双重优良性能。

Abstract: Latents from vision foundation models (VFMs) are semantically rich and well suited for visual understanding. Recent representation autoencoder methods such as RAE have shown that they can provide promising latent spaces for image generation. However, VFM latents remain difficult to model directly: DiT-generated latents exhibit spectral mismatch with encoder latents, especially in high-frequency components. Our channel-wise spectral analysis further reveals that these high-frequency components are diffusely distributed across latent channels and entangled with semantic information, making the latent space difficult for DiT to model. To address these challenges, we propose SPAE, latent adaptation framework for generation. Specifically, SPAE employs a compact bottleneck to distill stable semantic information while suppressing high-frequency components, thereby improving the alignment between DiT-generated latents and encoder latents. In addition, we apply a channel-wise masking strategy to promote the decoupling of semantic information and high-frequency details across bottleneck channels. Experiments show that SPAE achieves a favorable balance among visual understanding, generation quality, and reconstruction fidelity.

</details>


### [127] [Remember-R1: Mitigating Long-Context Visual Forgetting through Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01314)
*Jianmin Chen,Jiaqi Tang,Wei Wei,Xiaogang Xu,Jiafei Wu,Zhe Liu,Qianzhou Wang,Yingying Yan,Botong Geng,Yuyang Xia,Lei Zhang,Qifeng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Remember-R1，一个强化学习框架，通过在原始推理轨迹上应用过程级监督来缓解多模态大语言模型在长链思维推理中的视觉遗忘问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在长链思维推理中，随着推理序列变长，模型逐渐减少对视觉证据的依赖而更多依赖累积的文本上下文，导致视觉遗忘。现有方法未能直接在原始推理轨迹上约束视觉证据的使用和维护，长上下文视觉遗忘问题未得到充分解决。

Method: Remember-R1是一个强化学习框架，在原始推理轨迹上应用过程级监督，引入三类奖励：(1)鼓励覆盖更多匹配的视觉关键词；(2)强化后期推理步骤中对视觉依赖的持久性；(3)增加对与问题相关图像区域的关注度。

Result: 在多种模型规模和多个多模态基准上实验表明，Remember-R1一致地提升了推理性能。进一步分析显示，它减缓了生成过程中视觉注意力的下降，验证了其在缓解长上下文视觉遗忘方面的有效性。

Conclusion: Remember-R1通过过程级奖励直接约束原始推理轨迹中的视觉证据使用，有效缓解了长链推理中的视觉遗忘问题，为多模态推理中的视觉信息保持提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly rely on long chain-of-thought reasoning for complex tasks. However, as reasoning sequences lengthen, models may gradually rely less on visual evidence and more on accumulated textual context, leading to visual forgetting. Existing approaches do not directly constrain how visual evidence is used and maintained along the original reasoning trajectory, leaving long-context visual forgetting insufficiently addressed. To address this issue, we propose Remember-R1, a reinforcement learning framework that mitigates long-context visual forgetting by applying process-level supervision directly on the original reasoning trajectory. Specifically, Remember-R1 introduces rewards that encourage broader coverage of matched visual keywords, stronger persistence of visual dependence in later reasoning steps, and greater focus on question-relevant image regions. Experiments across multiple model scales and diverse multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that Remember-R1 consistently improves reasoning performance. Additional analyses further show that it slows the decline of visual attention during generation, supporting its effectiveness in mitigating long-context visual forgetting.

</details>


### [128] [SphereVideo: Prototype-anchored Hyperspherical Boundary for Continual AI-generated Video Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01334)
*Fei Li,Yue Yu,Yuran Wang,Xinghan Li,Jingjing Chen,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SphereVideo，一个用于AI生成视频检测的持续学习框架，通过在超球面上聚类真实视频特征并建模时序动态，实现了更好的可塑性与稳定性平衡，在已见和未见数据上分别超越先前方法3.08%和4.00%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI生成视频检测面临新生成模型不断涌现的挑战，现有检测器难以泛化到未见过的生成模型，因此需要持续学习来提升适应性。然而，针对该任务的持续学习框架尚未得到充分探索。

Method: SphereVideo包含两个核心策略：(1) 原型锚定——利用真实视频具有紧凑特征分布的观察，在超球面上让真实视频特征围绕一个真实原型聚类，同时排斥AI生成样本，形成决策边界，该原型作为持续学习的稳定锚点，调节边界演化并缓解灾难性遗忘；(2) 时序建模——在帧级和片段级两个层次建模真实数据的时序动态，避免仅依赖空间伪影作为捷径，通过加强真实数据建模进一步促进真实原型的学习和稳定决策边界的形成。此外，构建了一个全面且有挑战性的基准测试。

Result: 实验表明，SphereVideo在已见数据上比先前方法提升3.08%，在未见的AI生成数据上提升4.00%，实现了更好的可塑性-稳定性权衡。

Conclusion: 通过原型锚定与时序动态建模的结合，SphereVideo有效解决了AIGV检测中的持续学习挑战，在保持对已知数据识别能力的同时增强了对新生成模型的泛化能力。

Abstract: AI-generated video (AIGV) detection aims to distinguish real videos from AI-generated ones. In practice, detectors trained on existing data often fail to generalize to newly emerging generative models, making this task challenging. Therefore, continual learning (CL) is essential for improving the adaptability. However, CL frameworks for this task remain underexplored. To this end, we propose SphereVideo, a novel CL framework for AIGV detection built on two key observations. First, real videos exhibit a compact feature distribution. Based on this, we encourage real video features to cluster around a real prototype on a hypersphere while repelling AI-generated samples, thereby establishing a decision boundary. This prototype serves as a stable anchor for CL, regulating boundary evolution and mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Second, existing methods tend to rely solely on spatial artifacts as shortcuts. To enhance temporal modeling, we introduce a strategy that models the temporal dynamics of real data at both frame and clip levels. By strengthening real data modeling, this strategy further facilitates learning a real prototype and forming a stable decision boundary. Moreover, we construct a comprehensive and challenging benchmark. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SphereVideo achieves an improved plasticity-stability trade-off, outperforming prior methods by 3.08% on seen data and 4.00% on unseen AI-generated data.

</details>


### [129] [Asleep at the Wheel: JEPA's Limitations in Evaluating Novel Driving Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01336)
*Advait Pavuluri,Shamik Karkhanis,Uzma Mushtaque*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究自动驾驶视频片段的自动分流（clip triage）机制，探索使用自监督联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的预测误差作为"新颖性"评分来筛选值得人工审核的视频片段。研究发现，在跨数据集协议下该方法看似有效，但实际上是由于域偏移（domain shift）导致的假象；在单数据集的公平基准上，该方法退化为随机水平，而轻量监督探针在同一表征上AP几乎翻倍，表明瓶颈在于自监督目标而非表征本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶车队录制的视频量远超人工审查能力，亟需一种自动化的视频片段筛选机制来找出稀有且值得审查的片段，以便对驾驶模型进行微调以应对不理想的实际场景。作者希望评估无标签（label-free）方法在这种场景下的真实有效性。

Method: 使用冻结的V-JEPA视频编码器配合轻量级预测头，通过重建被掩蔽的片段嵌入来计算预测误差，以预测误差作为"新颖性"评分筛选值得关注的片段。评估协议包括一个看似真实的跨数据集训练/测试协议，以及一个来自单一数据集的公平基准。同时引入轻量监督探针（lightly supervised probe）进行对比实验。

Result: 在跨数据集协议下该方法表现"高度有效"，但作者证明这是域偏移的后果——在单数据集公平基准上，该方法退化为随机水平，与简单的免训练基线相当。而使用同一冻结嵌入的轻量监督探针，平均精度几乎翻倍，证明表征本身是有用的。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了跨数据集评估协议可能静默地奖励域分离而非真正的新颖性检测，对自监督学习方法的评估方式提出了重要警示。问题出在自监督目标（预测误差）与下游目标（稀有事件检测）之间的不匹配，而非嵌入表征质量。该工作可作为评估自监督学习有效性的研究案例。

Abstract: Modern autonomous-driving fleets record far more video than human reviewers can inspect. This motivates the need for an automatic clip triage mechanism, to surface rare and review-worthy clips, so that driving models can be fine-tuned to better handle unideal circumstances. We test a label-free approach that scores clips by the prediction-error "novelty" of a self-supervised joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA); a frozen V-JEPA video encoder is paired with a lightweight predictor head to reconstruct masked clip embeddings, and clips whose embeddings are hard to predict are flagged as interesting. Evaluated under a realistic protocol that trains on one dataset and tests against footage from others, this approach appears highly effective. We show that this apparent success is actually a domain-shift consequence: on a fair benchmark drawn from a single dataset, this mechanism collapses to chance and is on par with simple no-training baselines. A lightly supervised probe on the same frozen embeddings results in almost double the average precision, indicating that the bottleneck is indeed the self-supervised objective, rather than the representation. We present this as a study for evaluating the effectiveness of self-supervised learning, where cross-dataset protocols can silently reward domain separation over novelty.

</details>


### [130] [Driver2Map: Imitating Human Driving for Online High-Definition Map Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01338)
*Pan Yin,Runtian Xia,Weisong Kuang,Kaiyu Li,Cong Zhao,Xiangyong Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Driver2Map是一种在线高精地图构建模型，通过"两阶段对齐"策略、"位姿引导的BEV融合"模块和"预训练先验地图细化"模块，同时利用多视角相机图像、标准地图和卫星图像三种模态数据，在IoU和AP指标上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高清地图构建方法通常仅利用两种模态数据（如相机图像和标准地图），难以同时有效融合三种数据源（多视角相机图像、标准地图和卫星图像）。由于不同数据源之间存在模态差异和视角差异，现有方法难以有效对齐和融合这些信息，导致在线高清地图构建仍具有挑战性。

Method: 1) 两阶段对齐策略：减少不同模态之间的空间错位。2) 位姿引导的BEV融合模块：利用相机位姿信息自适应加权多视角特征，抑制BEV生成过程中的跨视角特征重叠。3) 预训练先验地图细化模块：通过学习地图结构先验来细化初始预测，改善动态遮挡下的高清地图预测。

Result: 大量实验表明，Driver2Map在IoU和AP两个评估指标上均优于现有方法，证明了同时利用三种模态数据及所提各模块的有效性。

Conclusion: Driver2Map通过灵感来源于人类驾驶员的思路，首次实现了同时利用三种模态数据进行在线高清地图构建，解决了多模态跨视角对齐与融合难题，显著提升了高清地图预测性能。

Abstract: High-definition (HD) maps are essential for autonomous driving systems. In constructing such maps, onboard multi-view camera images, standard-definition maps and satellite images provide crucial information. However, due to the modality and perspective differences among these data sources, existing methods often struggle to effectively align and fuse them, making online HD map construction still challenging. To address these issues, we propose Driver2Map, an online HD map construction model inspired by human drivers. Unlike existing HD map construction models that utilize only two modalities, our Driver2Map can simultaneously exploit three modalities. Specifically, we propose a "two-stage alignment" strategy to reduce spatial misalignment across different modalities. Additionally, we introduce "Pose-Guided BEV Fusion", a BEV (bird's-eye-view) generation module that leverages camera pose information to adaptively weight multi-view features, thereby effectively suppressing cross-view feature overlap during BEV generation. Also, we design a "Pretrained Prior for Map Refinement" module to refine the initial prediction by learning map structure priors, thus improving the HD map prediction under dynamic occlusions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Driver2Map outperforms existing methods on both IoU and AP metrics.

</details>


### [131] [DeVIT: Low-Power Vision Transformer Acceleration Using Delta Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01343)
*Reyhaneh Hosseinzadeh,Parham Zilouchian Moghaddam,Mehdi Modarressi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DeVIT，一种用于视觉Transformer的加速方法，通过利用低比特量化带来的值局部性（value locality）特性，采用差分计算实现无乘法器的矩阵乘法，从而在资源受限设备上降低计算复杂度和内存需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于Transformer的深度学习模型性能卓越，但在资源受限设备上部署面临高计算复杂度、大内存占用和带宽需求的挑战。虽然低比特量化已被用于减少内存使用并提升效率，但如何充分利用量化后参数的"值局部性"特性进一步加速计算仍然是一个未充分探索的方向。

Method: DeVIT利用量化后模型权重被限制在有限值范围内的特性，通过差分计算（differential computation）技术，将传统的矩阵乘法转换为无需乘法的运算方式，从而简化计算过程，实现对视觉Transformer的加速。

Result: DeVIT通过消除矩阵乘法中的乘法运算，显著降低了计算复杂度，同时借助低比特量化减少了内存大小和带宽需求，在资源受限场景下实现了效率提升。

Conclusion: DeVIT证明了在视觉Transformer中结合量化与差分计算可以有效地实现无乘法器的矩阵乘法加速，为资源受限设备上部署视觉Transformer提供了一种可行且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: The emergence of transformer-based deep learning models has brought unprecedented performance across various domains, particularly in natural language processing and computer vision. However, deploying these models, especially on resource-constrained devices, poses significant challenges due to their high computational complexity and large memory size and bandwidth requirements. This complexity has led researchers to use low-bit model weights to reduce memory usage and improve efficiency. In addition to reducing processing and memory demands, quantization introduces another useful property: value locality, where the extremely large number of parameters are restricted to a limited range of values. To fully take advantage of this locality, this paper presents DeVIT, an acceleration method for vision transformers that leverages differential computation to enable multiplier-less matrix multiplication.

</details>


### [132] [Prompt-Driven Simulation with Feature Perturbation for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01348)
*Linhai Zhuo,Junxi Cai,Tianwen Qian,Qingping Zheng,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PSP-FSOD框架，通过提示驱动的领域模拟和特征扰动正则化，解决跨域少样本目标检测中的领域偏移与标注数据稀缺问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨域少样本目标检测方法依赖传统数据增强（如Color-Jitter、Mosaic）和以背景为中心的适应策略（如Domain-RAG），在建模复杂领域偏移方面能力有限，导致性能次优。

Method: 1) 利用大型视觉-语言模型的视觉定位能力设计提示驱动策略，联合建模前景和背景变化，生成语义一致但领域多样的训练样本；2) 采用接地感知生成方案引导物体放置，缓解语义-空间错位；3) 引入噪声诱导的特征扰动机制，向多尺度中间特征注入高斯噪声并进行分布校正，鼓励扰动下预测的一致性，减少对领域特定线索的依赖。

Result: 在多个CD-FSOD基准上，PSP-FSOD生成高质量的领域多样监督并学习领域不变表示，性能持续提升。

Conclusion: 提示驱动的领域模拟结合特征扰动正则化能有效提升跨域少样本目标检测的泛化能力，为CD-FSOD提供了一个有原则的解决框架。

Abstract: Data augmentation, which simulates diverse visual variations to expand the source distribution and induce synthetic domain shifts, is a simple yet effective strategy for mitigating severe domain shifts and limited labeled target data in cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD). Existing approaches rely on conventional data augmentation, such as Color-Jitter, Mosaic, and background-centric adaptation (e.g., Domain-RAG), which are limited in modeling complex domain shifts and often lead to suboptimal performance. In this paper, we propose PSP-FSOD, a principled framework that integrates prompt-driven domain simulation with feature perturbation regularization to improve generalization in CD-FSOD. To enable controllable domain synthesis, we design a prompt-driven strategy that leverages the visual grounding capability of large VLMs to jointly model foreground and background variations, generating semantically consistent yet domain-diverse training samples. Moreover, we adopt a grounding-aware generation scheme that guides object placement and alleviates semantic-spatial misalignment, thereby improving foreground adaptation. To ensure training stability and robustness, we further introduce a noise-induced feature perturbation mechanism that injects Gaussian noise into multi-scale intermediate features with distribution correction, encouraging consistent predictions under perturbations and reducing reliance on domain-specific cues. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PSP-FSOD produces high-quality domain-diverse supervision and learns domain-invariant representations, consistently improving performance across CD-FSOD benchmarks.

</details>


### [133] [PixVL: Self-Supervised Training of Pixel-Level MLLMs via a Unified Mask--Text Consistency Cycle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01354)
*Yicheng Xiao,Haoxuan Ma,Caorui Li,Yucheng Wu,Weijie Wang,Haoxiao Wang,Shuang Chen,Fan Yang,Haiyun Guo,Jinqiao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PixVL是一个自监督后训练框架，通过统一的Mask-Text一致性循环（Confuser-aware语义验证和跨视角验证）解决像素级多模态大语言模型中区域分割与区域理解的两大挑战（掩码-文本对稀缺、训练信号干扰），实现了无需标注数据的自监督学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有像素级MLLM同时支持区域分割与区域理解，但面临两个根本性挑战：1）高质量掩码-文本对稀缺，大量掩码标注缺乏对应的语言监督；2）区域分割与区域理解在监督格式和学习信号密度上的差异导致优化干扰，使得两个任务相互竞争而非协同。

Method: PixVL提出统一的Mask-Text一致性循环框架，包含三个关键组件：1）Confuser-aware语义验证：利用模型在高度相似候选区域中正确选择目标的置信度来验证生成描述的语义质量，错误选择则赋予零奖励；2）交叉视角验证：使用时间上分离的视频帧或几何变换的图像视角，防止循环学习退化为位置和形状捷径；3）质量耦合的双向学习策略：用最高奖励的描述指导文本到掩码（Text-to-Mask）学习，将两个任务从竞争关系转变为相互生成与验证的关系。

Result: 实验表明PixVL同时提升了区域理解任务和区域分割任务的性能，证明该自监督框架能有效缓解标注稀缺和任务干扰问题。

Conclusion: PixVL通过自监督循环学习的新范式，将区域分割与区域理解从竞争任务转化为互补的生成器-验证器关系，为像素级MLLM在数据稀缺条件下的训练提供了可行方案，且循环的可靠性取决于语义验证而非单纯的几何重建指标。

Abstract: Recent studies develop pixel-level multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that support both Region Segmentation and Region Understanding, extending multimodal interaction from whole images to specific objects and regions. However, these methods face two fundamental challenges. First, the scarcity of high-quality mask--text pairs leaves abundant mask annotations without corresponding language supervision. Second, discrepancies in supervision formats and learning-signal densities induce optimization interference between Region Segmentation and Region Understanding. To address these challenges, we propose PixVL, a self-supervised post-training framework that introduces a unified Mask--Text Consistency Cycle, enabling pixel-level MLLMs to generate and self-verify regional descriptions and learn from unlabeled data. We found that direct cycle based solely on geometric reconstruction is unreliable because re-segmentation IoU does not faithfully reflect the semantic quality and referring sufficiency. PixVL therefore introduces confuser-aware semantic verification, which uses the model's confidence when it correctly chooses the target among highly similar candidate regions, and assigns zero reward to an incorrect choice. Meanwhile, PixVL performs cross-view verification using temporally separated video frames or geometrically transformed image views, preventing cyclic learning from collapsing to positional and shape shortcuts. Finally, a quality-coupled bidirectional learning strategy uses the highest-reward description to guide Text-to-Mask learning. This strategy transforms Region Understanding and Region Segmentation from competing tasks into mutual generators and verifiers. Experiments demonstrate that PixVL improves both region understanding task and segmentation task.

</details>


### [134] [CORTIVA: Candidate-Score Fusion of Complementary Visual Teachers for EEG- and MEG-to-Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01355)
*Junhan Wang,Kani Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CORTIVA，一种候选分数融合框架，用于从EEG/MEG非侵入性脑活动中解码视觉图像检索。与现有方法将异构视觉监督折叠成一个嵌入不同，CORTIVA将多个解码路径对齐到异构视觉目标，独立对同一候选图像集打分，仅在温度缩放后融合分数向量再进行排序。在THINGS-EEG2基准上达到73.5% Top-1和95.3% Top-5，分别超过最强基线10.3和5.4个百分点；在THINGS-MEG上达到42.4% Top-1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于对比对齐的零样本EEG/MEG图像检索系统普遍将异构视觉监督信号合并到单一嵌入空间中，再统一进行排序。这种早期整合不仅强制所有候选顺序共享一种相似性几何，还消除了不同编码器之间的分歧信息，从而丢失了互补性的视觉证据。

Method: CORTIVA采用候选分数融合策略：三条解码路线分别对齐到异构视觉目标，独立对同一候选图像集进行打分，仅将温度缩放的分数向量在排序之前进行组合。通过路线去除重训练和多种权重控制实验验证融合收益的来源。

Result: 在200类的THINGS-EEG2基准上，跨10名参与者达到73.5% Top-1和95.3% Top-5，分别超过最强基线10.3和5.4个百分点。使用模态特定的神经编码器时，同一融合原则在THINGS-MEG上达到42.4% Top-1。多种控制实验证明增益来自互补路线分数的整合，且无需专门加权规则。独立DINOv2分析复现了局部错误邻域和后验神经-视觉对应。

Conclusion: 候选分数融合框架为神经图像检索提供了一种比嵌入级整合更简单、可检验的替代方案，有效保留了编码器间的互补证据，显著提升了跨参与者、跨模态的检索性能。

Abstract: Decoding visual experience from non-invasive brain activity is central to neuroscience and brain-computer interfaces. Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) offers fine spatial detail, but its slow hemodynamics and burdensome acquisition limit temporally resolved decoding. Electroencephalography (EEG) and magnetoencephalography (MEG) provide millisecond resolution, making image retrieval compelling: identify the viewed image from one neural response and a fixed candidate bank. Contrastive alignment to pretrained visual representations enables zero-shot retrieval from EEG and MEG, but most systems collapse heterogeneous visual supervision into a single embedding before ranking. This early consolidation imposes one similarity geometry on every candidate order and removes encoder-specific disagreements from the final ranking. We propose CORTIVA, a candidate-score fusion framework that preserves this complementary evidence. Three decoding routes are aligned to heterogeneous visual targets, score the same indexed candidates independently, and combine only their temperature-scaled score vectors before ranking. On the 200-way THINGS-EEG2 benchmark, CORTIVA reaches 73.5% Top-1 and 95.3% Top-5 across ten participants, exceeding the strongest reported baseline by 10.3 and 5.4 percentage points. With a modality-specific neural encoder, the same fusion principle reaches 42.4% Top-1 on THINGS-MEG. Matched route-removal retraining and four weight controls demonstrate that CORTIVA's gain arises from integrating complementary route scores and persists with uniform weighting, without requiring a specialized weighting rule. Independent DINOv2 analyses further reproduce the local error neighborhoods and posterior neural-visual correspondence. These results establish candidate-score fusion as a simple and testable alternative to embedding-level consolidation for neural image retrieval.

</details>


### [135] [Harnessing Adversarial Distillation to Customise Debiased, Disease-Specific Pathology Foundation Models for Breast Cancer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01356)
*Zhiwei Chen,Yang Hu,Yuxiang Xiao,Yakun Ju,Tianyang Zhang,Yingxue Xu,Wei Li,Hao Chen,Jens Rittscher,Kaixiang Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SmartStu是一个针对乳腺癌定制的紧凑型病理基础模型（PFM）蒸馏框架，通过对抗性蒸馏抑制来自多教师PFM的混杂偏差（如位点特异信号和疾病不均衡），生成体积缩小30倍以上且性能基本保持甚至提升的乳腺癌特异性PFM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用病理基础模型（PFM）参数规模庞大（数十亿参数）导致计算成本高，且其跨癌种、多中心预训练引入非生物偏差（位点特异信号、疾病不均衡），在特定癌症（如乳腺癌）场景下易引发捷径学习，忽略微妙的形态学特征，限制了下游部署性能。

Method: SmartStu采用蒸馏框架：1）从多个教师PFM蒸馏表征至轻量级学生骨干网络；2）引入对抗性蒸馏，训练专用噪声模型以预测训练集中的干扰性边缘线索，鼓励学生识别但抑制与噪声目标相关的特征；3）融合多教师集成蒸馏与带伪影注入的自监督辅助目标。

Result: 在三个外部队列（Yale HER2、SLN-Breast、BRACS）上使用多种微型骨干网络验证，SmartStu生成的乳腺癌特异性PFM比通用PFM小30倍以上，同时下游性能（bAcc和AUC）基本保持甚至有所提升。

Conclusion: SmartStu通过对抗性蒸馏有效缓解了通用PFM在特定癌种应用中的混杂偏差问题，实现了计算成本与性能之间的良好权衡，为疾病特异性PFM的高效定制提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) provide strong tissue representations and have become central to digital pathology. However, deployment in disease-specific settings is limited by 1) the high computational cost of billion-parameter PFMs and 2) distribution mismatch and non-biological bias inherited from pan-cancer, multi-centre pre-training, including site-specific signatures and imbalanced disease prevalence. These factors can encourage shortcut learning and under-emphasise subtle morphology required for reliable modelling of a specific cancer type. We present SmartStu (a Smart Student), a framework to customise compact, breast-cancer-specific PFMs via distillation whilst mitigating confounding. SmartStu distils representations from multiple teacher PFMs into a lightweight student backbone. Crucially, we introduce adversarial distillation that leverages a dedicated noise model trained to predict nuisance, edge-dominated cues on the distillation set. Using this noise model as a counterexample, the adversarial objective encourages the student to recognise, yet suppress, features predictive of nuisance targets. We further incorporate multi-teacher ensemble distillation and an auxiliary self-supervised objective with artefact injection. We validate SmartStu on three external cohorts (Yale HER2, SLN-Breast, and BRACS) with multiple tiny backbones. SmartStu yields breast-cancer-specific PFMs that are over $30\times$ smaller than general PFMs whilst largely preserving, and sometimes improving, downstream performance measured by balanced accuracy (bAcc) and AUC. Code is available at https://github.com/zwchen03/advDistall.

</details>


### [136] [Understanding Synergistic Interactions among Pathology Foundation Models via Adaptive Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01370)
*Yuxiang Xiao,Yang Hu,Bin Li,Tianyang Zhang,Zexi Li,Huazhu Fu,Jens Rittscher,Kaixiang Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AdaFusion是一个轻量级自适应融合框架，通过低维特征压缩和样本条件门控机制整合多个冻结的病理学基础模型（PFM）的互补信号，在提升预测精度的同时提供基于贡献的可解释性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理学基础模型（PFM）虽能通过自监督预训练提供强大的tile级表示，但由于数据、架构和目标函数的多样性且不透明性，不同PFM会产生潜在的表征偏差，限制其鲁棒性并模糊了各模型的专长领域。需要一种方法集成多个PFM的互补信号以提高性能并理解模型特性。

Method: AdaFusion框架包含两个核心组件：(1)低维特征压缩，用于降低特征维度；(2)样本条件门控模块，用于对模型级（可选通道级）贡献进行重新加权。这些模块在冻结的PFM之上进行轻量级集成，实现自适应融合。

Result: 在三个公开基准数据集（治疗响应预测、前列腺癌分级、空间基因表达推断）上，AdaFusion一致优于单个PFM和其他融合基线方法，同时提供可解释的组织可视化，使模型偏好与形态学模式对齐。

Conclusion: AdaFusion不仅有效提升病理学任务的预测性能，还通过贡献驱动的解释揭示各PFM的模型特定偏好与跨组织表型的协同交互，提供了较强的可解释性和实用价值。

Abstract: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) provide strong tile-level representations via self-supervised pre-training on large-scale pathology images. Yet, PFMs are developed under diverse and often opaque data, architecture, and objective choices, inducing latent representational biases that limit robustness and obscure what each model specialises in. We present AdaFusion, a lightweight adaptive fusion framework that integrates complementary signals from multiple frozen PFMs through (1) low-dimensional feature compression and (2) a sample-conditioned gating module that reweights model-wise (and optionally channel-wise) contributions. Beyond improving predictive accuracy, AdaFusion provides contribution-driven interpretation that offers evidence consistent with model-specific preferences and synergistic interactions across tissue phenotypes. We evaluate AdaFusion on three public benchmarks spanning treatment response prediction, prostate cancer grading, and spatial gene expression inference. AdaFusion consistently outperforms individual PFMs and other fusion baselines, while providing interpretable tissue visualisation which aligns model preferences with morphological patterns. Code is available at: https://github.com/xyx-98/PathoOracle.

</details>


### [137] [FineMoLA: Towards Fine-Grained Motion-Language Alignment from Clip-Level Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01392)
*Tongyan Wang,Zhengyuan Li,Muhan Lin,Shengyang Luo,Yifan Shen,Aniket Bera,Baijian Yang,Yingjie Victor Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FineMoLA，一种弱监督框架，通过最优传输问题直接从剪辑级标注中学习细粒度的帧-短语对应关系，实现动作帧与文本之间的细粒度对齐和时序精确的运动生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的运动-语言数据集即使包含丰富的长文本描述，也仅在剪辑级别提供监督，缺乏运动帧与语言之间显式的时间对应关系，这限制了细粒度的运动-文本对齐和时序精确的生成能力。

Method: 首先将长文本描述分割为包含动作的短语，然后将运动-语言对齐公式化为最优传输问题，利用熵正则化和Sinkhorn迭代在全局约束下高效推断伪帧级对齐，无需人工标注。

Result: 在SnapMoGen数据集上的实验表明，学习到的对齐在运动-文本接地任务中优于基线方法。

Conclusion: FineMoLA通过弱监督方式有效实现了细粒度的帧-短语对齐，解决了剪辑级监督不足的问题，提高了运动-文本接地的精度。

Abstract: Text-conditioned human motion generation has made rapid progress with the emergence of large-scale motion--language datasets. However, even datasets with rich long-form descriptions typically provide supervision only at the clip level, without explicit temporal correspondence between motion frames and language. This limits fine-grained motion--text grounding and temporally precise generation. We propose FineMoLA, a weakly supervised framework that learns fine-grained frame--phrase correspondence directly from clip-level annotations. Our method first segments long-form descriptions into action-bearing phrases, and then formulates motion--language alignment as an optimal transport problem, which naturally models many-to-many relations between motion frames and text under global constraints. With entropic regularization and Sinkhorn iterations, FineMoLA efficiently infers pseudo frame-level alignments without human labeling. Experiments on SnapMoGen demonstrate that the learned alignments outperform baselines in motion--text grounding.

</details>


### [138] [Training-Free Out-of-Distribution Detection for Pathology Whole-Slide Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01407)
*Sabri Mustafa Kahya,Richard R. Chen,Muhammet Sami Yavuz,Jerry Jierui Lou,Akanimoh Adeleye,Haci Ali Kahya,Jana Lipkova*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ZIO是一种无需训练的多模态OOD检测器，利用病理视觉-语言基础模型构建文本和视觉原型，通过原型收缩机制整合信息，用于全切片图像（WSIs）的分布外检测，在14,700+张WSIs上优于40种现有OOD方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在计算病理学中，OOD检测对于确保AI系统在临床中的安全部署至关重要。然而，WSIs的千兆像素尺度、疾病亚型之间的细微差异以及组织制备的变异性，使得通用OOD方法难以直接应用。计算病理学中的OOD检测仍然不成熟。

Method: ZIO利用病理视觉-语言基础模型，构建分布内类别的文本和视觉原型，通过原型收缩机制（prototype shrinkage mechanism）整合两种模态的互补信息，推导出OOD分数。该方法同时支持切片级和补丁级基础模型的公式化，且无需训练。

Result: 在来自五个独立联盟的超过14,700张WSI上进行评估，覆盖罕见疾病和近OOD等临床相关领域偏移场景，ZIO一致性地优于单模态原型以及40种最先进的OOD方法。

Conclusion: 多模态表征对OOD检测具有明确优势，ZIO为计算病理学中的安全AI临床部署提供了可靠保障，有望推动AI在临床实践中的更安全应用。

Abstract: Safe deployment of AI methods in medicine requires robust guardrails that detect when input data deviate from the training distribution to ensure that models provide predictions only within their scope of expertise and abstain otherwise. Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection can provide such safeguards and is extensively studied in general computer vision. Yet, it remains underdeveloped in computational pathology, where gigapixel whole-slide images (WSIs), subtle differences between disease subtypes, and variability in tissue preparation pose unique challenges for conventional OOD methods. We propose ZIO, a training-free, multimodal OOD detector for pathology WSIs that leverages vision--language pathology foundation models (FMs). ZIO constructs text and visual prototypes of in-distribution classes and integrates their complementary information through a prototype shrinkage mechanism to derive OOD scores. We provide the ZIO formulation for both slide- and patch-level FMs. We evaluate ZIO across diverse clinically relevant domain shifts, including rare diseases and near-OOD settings. Extensive evaluation of over 14,700 WSIs from five independent consortia shows that ZIO consistently outperforms both unimodal prototypes and 40 state-of-the-art OOD methods. These results demonstrate the benefits of multimodal representation for OOD detection and pave the way towards safer AI deployment in clinical practice.

</details>


### [139] [PackingGPT: 3D Packing Agent for Real Furniture in Last-Mile Delivery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01427)
*Yi You,Hui Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向真实场景的异构家具装入车辆（furniture-in-vehicle）装箱任务的基准数据集与基线模型 PackingGPT。该任务比标准集装箱装箱更复杂，需考虑异构箱体（不同尺寸和重量）以及已被占用（如已放置杂货）的容器，同时需满足物理稳定性（质心 CoM 约束）。实验表明，忽略 CoM 约束的基线方法在轿车模拟中平均有 10-40% 的箱子无法通过稳定性检查，而在训练时施加 CoM 约束的 LLP 模型可将失败率降至 0.67%（SUV-500）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准集装箱装箱算法无法处理现实场景中更复杂的条件，例如购买家具装入私家车时的任务面临异构箱体（尺寸和重量各异）、已占用的容器空间（如车内存有杂货）以及物理稳定性要求。现有算法忽略了质心约束，导致现实应用中不稳定放置。因此需要一个新的数据集和相应的模型来解决这一实际但被忽视的问题。

Method: 论文提出：(1) 一个基于真实家具公司平板包装数据的基准数据集，通过家族级外推覆盖大量目录产品，保证长度、宽度、高度和重量的多样性；(2) PackingGPT 框架，受乐高组装过程启发，将装箱视为顺序放置任务，异构箱体（积木）逐步放入不规则剩余货舱空间（创作物）中；(3) 对五个基线装箱方法在不考虑质心约束下进行测试，并训练 LLP 模型在放置过程中强制施加质心约束。

Result: 在轿车模拟中，五个未考虑质心约束的基线方法平均有 10-40% 的放置箱子未通过稳定性检查；而在放置过程中强制执行质心约束后训练的 LLP 模型，SUV-500 场景下失败率降低至 0.67%。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，仅优化空间利用率而不考虑物理稳定性的装箱方法在真实家具装入车辆场景中会产生大量不稳定放置；通过在训练/放置过程中显式施加质心约束，可以大幅降低稳定性失败率，验证了 PackingGPT 框架及所提供基准数据集的实用价值。

Abstract: 3D bin packing rectangular items into standardised containers to maximise space utilisation under geometric shipping automation. Loading a furniture purchase into a personal vehicle is the same task, but under more complex conditions that standard container loading algorithms ignore. This paper addresses the physically stable placement under these realistic conditions with heterogeneous boxes (e.g. varying dimensions and weights) and occupied containers (e.g. groceries). This paper provides a real-world benchmark dataset and baseline model for the Heterogeneous furniture-in-vehicle packing task. The dataset uses real furniture company flat-pack packaging data covering a large number of catalogue products via family-level extrapolation with diversity length, widths, heights, and weights. We also propose a PackingGPT framework for packing as a sequential placement inspired by the Lego assembly process, where heterogeneous boxes of varying dimensions (bricks) are placed step-by-step into the irregular remaining cargo space (creations). Five baseline packing methods were tested on our dataset without considering the Centre-of- Mass (CoM) constraints. In sedan car simulations, 10-40% of placed boxes failed the stability check on average. When the LLP model was trained on packing sequences with CoM constraints enforced during placement, the failure rate dropped to 0.67% (SUV-500).

</details>


### [140] [Long-Horizon Embodied Decision-Making via Multimodal Memory Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01456)
*Bingxuan Li,Rui Yang,Cheng Qian,Jiateng Liu,Jeonghwan Kim,Zhenhailong Wang,Manling Li,Tong Zhang,Heng Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DunphyBench基准，用于评估智能体在长期、以人为本的具身决策任务中的表现，并发现现有VLM驱动的智能体与人类表现存在显著差距，其中记忆管理是主要瓶颈。基于此，作者设计了MeMento，一种偏好条件化的多模态记忆压缩器，通过固定数量的记忆token选择性压缩决策相关信息，使智能体准确率提升7.18%同时内存使用减少85.38%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体正从单纯的任务执行者转变为代表人类用户做决策的角色，需要在长时间跨度内积累证据、理解隐含的用户偏好，并在部分观察条件下比较多个候选方案。然而现有基准多聚焦于程序性规划或即时目标完成，缺乏对长期、以人为本的具身决策能力的系统评估。

Method: 1) 提出DunphyBench基准，要求智能体在多个具身家庭环境中导航，并做出符合多维度人类偏好的决策；2) 对现有VLM驱动智能体进行诊断，识别记忆管理为关键瓶颈；3) 设计MeMento，一个偏好条件化的多模态记忆压缩器，利用固定数量的记忆token根据用户偏好选择性压缩长期历史中的决策相关信息。

Result: 实验表明，当前智能体与人类表现存在显著差距；MeMento帮助VLM驱动智能体在准确率上提升7.18%，同时内存使用相比最强基线减少85.38%。

Conclusion: 长期以人为本的具身决策仍是开放挑战，偏好条件化的记忆压缩机制能有效提升决策质量与效率，为未来智能体在长期决策场景中的发展提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Agents are increasingly expected to act not only as task executors, but also as decision-makers on behalf of human users. This shift requires agents to accumulate evidence over long horizons, interpret implicit user preferences, and compare multiple candidates under partial observations. In this work, we propose DunphyBench, a new benchmark for evaluating agents on long-horizon human-centered embodied decision-making, where the agent must navigate through multiple embodied housing environments and make decisions that align with multi-dimensional human preferences. Unlike standard embodied reasoning tasks that often focus on procedural planning or immediate goal completion, our setting requires agents to integrate multimodal, multi-source input into coherent knowledge that supports complex reasoning across long horizon. The evaluation results reveal that there is a substantial gap between current agents and human performance. Furthermore, our diagnosis of state-of-the-art VLM-driven agents reveals that memory management is one of the bottlenecks, where raw multimodal history introduces noise that hinders decision quality. Motivated by this finding, we design MeMento, a preference-conditioned multimodal memory compressor that selectively compresses decision-relevant information from long-horizon history based on user preferences with a fixed set of memory tokens. Experiments show that MeMento helps VLM-driven agents improve accuracy by 7.18%, while reducing memory usage by 85.38% compared to the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [141] [VGER: Voxel-Guided Global Event Ranking for Event Cloud Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01470)
*Youxin Jiang,Baoheng Fu,Hongwei Ren,Xiangqian Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VGER（Voxel-Guided Global Event Ranking），一个无需训练的归因框架，用于基于点的事件云网络。VGER结合事件级梯度证据与任务感知的体素扰动证据，将区域贡献转化为事件级归因分数，并提出统一的事件排序策略。在三个事件基准、三个骨干网络（PointNet、PointNet++、EventMamba）共九种设置下，VGER在高低尾删除性能上均优于点级显著性基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机产生稀疏异步事件流，基于事件点的模型虽性能优异，但预测背后的事件级证据难以识别。直接套用点云的点级显著性方法虽能提供细粒度归因，却忽略了事件特有的时空结构，因此需要针对事件点云网络设计专门的归因方法以提升模型透明性和可靠性。

Method: VGER由三部分组成：(1) 事件级梯度证据：直接从事件点获取细粒度梯度归因；(2) 任务感知体素扰动证据：通过体素化扰动获得区域贡献，弥补梯度方法对时空结构感知不足的问题；(3) 统一事件排序策略：将区域贡献转移至事件级归因分数，对事件进行排序——高排名事件为预测关键，低排名事件对预测影响有限。

Result: 在三个事件基准数据集上，结合PointNet、PointNet++和EventMamba三种骨干网络，共九种数据集-骨干网络设置下，VGER一致地提升了高尾和低尾删除性能，均优于点级显著性基线方法。

Conclusion: VGER通过融合事件级梯度证据与体素扰动证据，在不依赖训练的情况下实现了对事件点云网络的有效归因解释，同时兼顾细粒度分辨率和事件时空结构感知，为事件相机感知模型的可解释性提供了新思路。

Abstract: Event cameras produce sparse and asynchronous event streams that provide rich spatio-temporal information for efficient perception. Recent advances in event-based models have demonstrated strong performance by directly modeling asynchronous events without dense frame reconstruction. However, identifying the event-level evidence behind their predictions is crucial for improving model transparency and reliability. Directly adapting point-level saliency methods from point clouds provides fine-grained attribution but overlooks event-specific spatio-temporal structures. To address this limitation, we propose Voxel-Guided Global Event Ranking (VGER), a training-free attribution framework for point-based event cloud networks. VGER combines event-level gradient evidence with task-aware voxel perturbation evidence, transferring regional contribution into event-level attribution scores while preserving fine-grained resolution. Furthermore, VGER introduces a unified event ranking strategy, where high-ranked events are expected to be prediction-critical and low-ranked events are expected to have limited influence on predictions. We evaluate VGER on three event-based benchmarks with PointNet, PointNet++, and EventMamba. Across nine dataset-backbone settings, VGER consistently improves both high-tail and low-tail deletion performance over point-level saliency baselines.

</details>


### [142] [Slot2Text: Object-Centric Visual Tokenization for Efficient and Spatially Traceable Surgical MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01473)
*Guiqiu Liao,Matjaz Jogan,Daniel A. Hashimoto*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Slot2Text是一个双模式手术多模态大语言模型（MLLM），用紧凑的槽位潜在变量（slot latents）替代密集视觉token，将视觉输入压缩为区域标签化的token。Slot2Text-Fast模式能以极低token消耗（平均减少91.8%）达到与SOTA基线竞争的性能；Slot2Text-Reason模式提供显式区域定位和可追溯的空间证据，实现低成本和可解释性的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手术场景理解MLLM将数百个密集视觉token注入语言模型，导致推理成本高昂，且生成的答案缺乏空间可追溯性。研究者希望通过紧凑的视觉表示来解决成本与可解释性的双重瓶颈。

Method: Slot2Text通过自监督视觉特征分组将视觉输入编码为少量区域（slots），作为带区域标签的视觉token供语言模型消费，无需依赖视觉编码器与语言的对比性对齐。提供两种模式：Slot2Text-Fast（使用槽位前缀直接回答手术问题）和Slot2Text-Reason（额外识别和定位推理相关区域，将语言输出链接到对应的槽位token、掩码或区域）。

Result: 在多个视觉问答和视觉定位基准上，Slot2Text-Fast以显著更低的成本达到与SOTA基线竞争的性能：平均总token消耗降低91.8%，视觉前缀从1295个token降至47个（减少96.4%）。Slot2Text-Reason以额外token和延迟为代价换取显式区域身份、位置和可追溯的空间证据。

Conclusion: 紧凑的槽位潜在变量可作为手术MLLM的高效默认视觉接口，在需要更高空间可追溯性时再调用基于grounded reasoning的推理模式，为手术场景理解提供了成本效率和可解释性之间的灵活权衡方案。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLM) for surgical scene understanding typically inject hundreds of dense visual tokens into a language model, leading to costly inference and limited spatial traceability for generated answers. We present Slot2Text, a dual-mode surgical MLLM that replaces dense representations of visual input with a compact set of regions encoded as slot latents. Instead of relying on contrastive alignment of the visual encoder with language, Slot2Text groups self-supervised vision features into a few regions--slots that are consumed by the language model as area-labeled visual tokens. Slot2Text-Fast uses the slot prefix to answer surgical questions. Slot2Text-Reason also identifies and locates areas relevant for reasoning, linking language outputs to corresponding slot tokens, masks or regions. Experiments on multiple visual question answering and visual grounding benchmarks show that Slot2Text-Fast is competitive with state-of-the-art baseline at a much lower cost, reducing the average total token consumption by a 91.8\% and the visual prefix from 1,295 to 47 tokens (a 96.4\% reduction). Slot2Text-Reason trades additional tokens and latency for explicit area identities, locations, and traceable spatial evidence. These results establish compact slot latents as an efficient default visual interface for surgical MLLMs, with grounded reasoning invoked when greater spatial traceability is required.

</details>


### [143] [Towards Compact Unified Multimodal Tracking: Synergizing Knowledge Distillation with Structural Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01488)
*Yuqi Li,Yuedong Tan,Huiran Duan,Weilun Feng,Chuanguang Yang,Zhulin An,Zongwei Wu,Shiping Wen,Tingwen Huang,Yingli Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出双对齐蒸馏框架（Dual-Alignment Distillation），通过精简解码器架构并解耦知识迁移为空间表征对齐和语义分布对齐两个互补流，在统一多模态目标跟踪任务中实现了轻量级模型的高效部署，在RGBT234上达到91.5% MPR并实现54 FPS的实时推理速度（较教师模型5倍加速）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然统一多模态目标跟踪通过融合RGB、热红外、深度等多模态数据实现了卓越的鲁棒性，但最先进模型的计算负担过重，难以部署在资源受限的边缘设备上。作者识别出预测头是常被忽视的关键效率瓶颈，但精简解码器结构同时引入了轻量学生模型与重型教师模型之间的能力差距，需要通过有效的知识蒸馏来弥补。

Method: 该方法包含三个核心部分：(1) 识别预测头作为效率瓶颈并战略性精简解码器架构以释放实时推理潜力；(2) 对17种蒸馏策略进行系统分析；(3) 提出双对齐蒸馏框架，将知识迁移解耦为两个互补流——空间表征对齐（使用特征蒸馏强化学生对前景目标的空间聚焦，解决"跟踪哪里"的问题）和语义分布对齐（使用基于logit的蒸馏对齐决策边界并迁移判别性暗知识，解决"跟踪什么"的问题）。

Result: 在五个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明该方法显著优于复杂的现有技术方法。蒸馏模型在RGBT234上达到91.5% MPR，在单张RTX 4090上运行速度为54 FPS，相较于教师模型实现了5倍加速，同时保持了更优的精度。

Conclusion: 通过将知识蒸馏解耦为空间表征对齐和语义分布对齐两个互补流，可以在解决轻量学生与重型教师能力差距的同时实现高效的多模态目标跟踪部署，兼顾了实时推理速度与优越的跟踪精度。

Abstract: Unified multimodal object tracking has achieved remarkable robustness by leveraging complementary sensor data (e.g., RGB, Thermal, Depth), yet the heavy computational burden of state-of-the-art models hinders their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. In this work, we identify the prediction head as a critical but often overlooked efficiency bottleneck. By strategically streamlining the decoder architecture, we unlock the potential for real-time inference but simultaneously introduce a capacity gap between the lightweight student and the heavy teacher. To resolve this, we conduct a systematic analysis of 17 distillation strategies and introduce a Dual-Alignment Distillation framework. Our key insight is that effective compression requires decoupling knowledge transfer into two complementary streams: (1) Spatial Representation Alignment, which employs feature distillation to sharpen the student's spatial focus on foreground targets ("Where to track"); and (2) Semantic Distribution Alignment, which utilizes logit-based distillation to align decision boundaries and transfer discriminative dark knowledge ("What to track"). Extensive experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms complex state-of-the-art methods. Notably, our distilled model achieves 91.5% MPR on RGBT234 and operates at 54 FPS on a single RTX 4090, representing a 5x speedup over the teacher model while maintaining superior accuracy.

</details>


### [144] [GaussianSelector: Lightweight Human-Guided Object Selection in 3D Gaussian Splatting with Graph Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01492)
*Baihan Yang,Tiexin Li,Yuheng Liu,Xin Lin,Xinke Li,Xiaohui Xie,Truong Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GaussianSelector是一种无需训练的交互式3D物体选择框架，直接在Gaussian原语上操作，通过超点粗化、连续性加权图和全局图割能量最小化，从稀疏视图和稀疏scribble引导中实现完整的3D物体选择，支持多轮交互修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的3DGS-based物体选择方法要么需要重新训练Gaussian表示以嵌入逐物体标签，要么需要构建密集的多视图SAM观测，两者都要求高昂的计算成本和密集视角覆盖，这在实际应用场景中很少可用。因此需要一种轻量级、训练免费的交互式3D选择方法。

Method: GaussianSelector在原生Gaussian原语上运行：首先将密集Gaussian粗化为几何一致的超点，利用外观和空间线索构建连续性加权图；然后通过可见性感知透过率覆盖将稀疏用户描边提升到3D；最后将选择问题建模为全局图割能量最小化，将稀疏证据传播到完整3D物体。该方法天然支持多轮交互细化。

Result: 实验表明GaussianSelector在分割质量上与最先进的多视图SAM方法相当，但所需交互视图数量显著更少，计算开销大幅降低。

Conclusion: GaussianSelector在很少的交互视图和低计算成本下实现竞争性分割质量，非常适合人机协同的3D场景编辑和实际部署中的3D资产提取。

Abstract: Selecting a complete 3D object from a reconstructed scene with minimal user effort is essential for practical scene editing and embodied interaction. Existing 3DGS-based methods either retrain the Gaussian representation to embed per-object labels, or build dense multi-view SAM observations, both requiring heavy computation and dense viewpoint coverage that is rarely available in practice. We present GaussianSelector, a training-free framework for interactive 3D object selection from sparse views and sparse scribble guidance. Operating directly on native Gaussian primitives, we coarsen dense Gaussians into geometrically coherent superpoints and construct a continuity-weighted graph using appearance and spatial cues. Sparse user scribbles are lifted into 3D via visibility-aware transmittance coverage, and selection is solved as a global graph-cut energy minimization that propagates sparse evidence to a complete 3D object. This design naturally supports multi-round refinement, where users iteratively correct the selection from additional viewpoints to progressively improve the result. Experiments demonstrate that GaussianSelector achieves competitive selection quality against state-of-the-art multi-view SAM-based methods, while requiring significantly fewer interaction views and substantially lower computational overhead. These properties make it well suited for human-in-the-loop 3D scene editing and 3D asset extraction in real-world deployment scenarios.

</details>


### [145] [Probing the 3D Object-Level Understanding of Pre-Trained Detection Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01495)
*Robin Kim,Colin Samplawski,Benjamin M. Marlin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文调查了预训练的2D检测Transformer模型（如DETR及其扩展）在对象级嵌入中隐含的3D物体属性信息，通过线性和非线性探针发现，即使没有3D监督训练，这些模型也能出人意料地强表示物体的深度和相对于摄像机的3D位置信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注2D检测Transformer的2D能力，但对其对象级嵌入中是否隐含了3D几何信息（如深度、3D位置）缺乏系统探索。理解这一点对3D感知任务和跨模态迁移具有重要意义。

Method: 使用线性和非线性探针（probing classifiers）对多种2D检测Transformer模型（DETR及其扩展）的对象级嵌入进行解码，分别评估从嵌入中恢复物体深度和相对于摄像机的3D位置的能力，并跨多个模型架构进行对比验证。

Result: 实验结果表明，尽管2D检测Transformer在预训练过程中完全没有3D监督，其对象级嵌入中却意外地包含了丰富的3D属性信息，能够以惊人的强度恢复物体深度和3D位置信息，且该能力在多种模型架构中一致存在。

Conclusion: 2D检测Transformer在无3D监督下隐式学习到了物体的3D几何表征，这揭示了DETR类模型具有比预期更强的3D感知能力，为后续利用2D预训练模型进行3D任务提供了新的可能。

Abstract: Detection transformer models, including DETR and its extensions, learn to output a set of object-level embeddings that can be simultaneously decoded into 2D bounding boxes and class distributions. In this paper, we investigate what pre-trained 2D detection transformers understand about the 3D properties of objects. Specifically, we investigate the extent to which properties including the depth of objects from the camera and the 3D location of objects relative to the camera can be recovered from object-level embeddings using linear and non-linear probes. Across a range of detection transformer models, our results show a surprisingly strong and previously unknown ability of 2D DETR models to represent useful information about the 3D properties of objects, despite the complete lack of 3D supervision during model pre-training.

</details>


### [146] [Rolling Shutter Camera Self-Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01509)
*Yongcong Zhang,Navid Rabbani,Bangyan Liao,Chengbo Wang,Yizhen Lao,Adrien Bartoli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个针对卷帘快门（RS）相机的自标定方法，无需标定板或专用硬件，直接从图像序列估计相机内参和读出时间比。方法通过结合两种互补的RS成像模型（连续时间轨迹估计与全局快门时间扭曲模型），构建统一的"双投影模型"自标定光束法平差（BA），在每个3D点上同时施加行相关和参考时间戳的约束，增强几何与时间一致性。仿真和真实数据实验验证了方法的准确性、鲁棒性和实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卷帘快门相机在消费级设备中广泛使用，但行式曝光在运动下会产生畸变，其几何3D视觉问题同时依赖相机内参和读出时间比。现有RS标定方法依赖标定目标或专用硬件，无法在无约束场景中使用，因此需要一种无需标定板的自标定方法。

Method: 将RS自标定实现为自标定光束法平差（BA），核心在于RS成像模型。方法组合两个已知的互补模型：(1) 将RS成像建模为行相关位姿表示下的连续时间轨迹估计；(2) 将RS图像解释为时间扭曲的全局快门（GS）图像，需要估计校正场。两者的组合得到统一的"双投影模型"，每个3D点在一个共享连续轨迹上同时受到行相关时间戳和参考时间戳的双重约束，从而加强几何和时间一致性。

Result: 广泛的仿真实验分析了多种实现在不同条件下的适用性；真实数据实验证明了该方法在准确性、鲁棒性和实际有效性方面的优势。

Conclusion: 该方法首次实现了无需标定目标的RS相机自标定，通过统一的双投影模型框架同时估计相机内参和读出时间比，为无约束场景下的RS相机3D视觉提供了一种实用的自标定方案。

Abstract: Rolling shutter (RS) cameras are widely used in consumer devices, but their row-wise exposure causes distortions under motion, making geometric 3D vision problems dependent on both camera intrinsics and readout time ratio. Existing RS calibration methods rely on calibration targets or specialised hardware, limiting their use in unconstrained settings. We present the first self-calibration method for RS cameras that directly estimates camera intrinsics and the readout time ratio from image sequences, without requiring calibration targets. The method is implemented as a self-calibrating bundle adjustment (BA), which critically depends on the RS imaging model. We combine two known complementary models. The first formulates RS imaging as continuous-time trajectory estimation under a row-wise pose representation. The second interprets RS images as temporally distorted global shutter (GS) images and requires to estimate correction fields. The combination is non-trivial and results in a unified dual-projection model, in which each 3D point is simultaneously constrained at both row-dependent and reference timestamps along a shared continuous trajectory, enforcing stronger geometric and temporal consistency. Extensive simulations analyse the applicability of several implementations under varying conditions, and real data experiments demonstrate the accuracy, robustness, and practical effectiveness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [147] [UCBound-Net: Uncertainty-Guided Boundary-Aware Continual Learning for Domain-Incremental Ultrasound Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01518)
*Mohammad Amanour Rahman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出UCBound-Net，一种利用MC Dropout不确定性作为空间遗忘风险代理的持续分割框架，通过三重组件（不确定性加权边界蒸馏、不确定性校准正则化、不确定性引导的样本选择）在乳腺超声到甲状腺超声的持续学习场景中显著缓解灾难性遗忘，BWT从-0.173改善至-0.098，平均DSC达0.755。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床影像持续学习中，模型在学习新解剖域时面临灾难性遗忘的挑战。现有的正则化和知识蒸馏策略将所有空间区域平等对待，忽视了预测不确定性与遗忘倾向之间的强相关性，因此缺乏针对性的遗忘缓解手段。

Method: UCBound-Net包含三个协同组件：(1) 不确定性加权边界蒸馏——在冻结教师模型的高熵区域放大知识迁移信号；(2) 不确定性校准正则化——显式惩罚过度自信的错误预测；(3) 不确定性引导的样本选择——优先存储边界区域预测熵最高的样本到记忆缓冲区。

Result: 在顺序域增量基准（BUSI任务1→TN3K任务2）上，UCBound-Net相对于朴素微调将BWT从-0.173改善至-0.098，两任务平均DSC达0.755，超越基线方法且无需任务边界监督。消融实验证实每个组件独立贡献遗忘缓解效果。

Conclusion: 不确定性感知的持续学习为临床图像分割提供了一条实用路径，证明了将空间不确定性作为遗忘风险代理的有效性。

Abstract: Continual learning in clinical imaging faces a dual challenge: a model must assimilate knowledge from new anatomical domains while retaining representations learned from prior tasks, a problem known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing mitigation strategies, including regularization and knowledge distillation, treat all spatial regions equally, ignoring the fact that prediction uncertainty is strongly correlated with the propensity for forgetting. We introduce UCBound-Net, a continual segmentation framework that exploits Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout uncertainty as a spatial proxy for forgetting risk. Our method contributes three synergistic components: (i) uncertainty-weighted boundary distillation, which amplifies the knowledge transfer signal at high-entropy regions of the frozen teacher; (ii) uncertainty-calibration regularization, which explicitly penalizes overconfident erroneous predictions; and (iii) uncertainty-guided exemplar selection, a memory buffer that preferentially stores samples whose boundary regions exhibit the highest predictive entropy. Evaluated on a sequential domain-incremental benchmark comprising breast ultrasound (BUSI, Task 1) followed by thyroid ultrasound (TN3K, Task 2), UCBound-Net reduces forgetting relative to naive fine-tuning, achieving a backward transfer (BWT) of -0.098 compared with -0.173, while obtaining an average Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 0.755 across both tasks. The proposed framework outperforms baseline methods without requiring task-boundary supervision. An ablation study further demonstrates that each component contributes independently to forgetting mitigation, providing a practical pathway toward uncertainty-aware continual learning for clinical image segmentation.

</details>


### [148] [ST-LoRA: Single Trajectory LoRA Ensemble for Uncertainty Aware Agricultural Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01530)
*Mohamed Farag,Genc Hoxha,Yahia Maleki,Chris McCool,Ribana Roscher*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ST-LoRA，一种将低秩适应（LoRA）与快照集成结合的参数高效集成框架，用于农业语义分割任务，仅用不到10%的可训练参数构建多样化集成成员，在分割精度、校准质量和分布外检测方面匹配或超越全秩集成方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字农业中的可靠决策支持需要准确的预测和良好的不确定性估计，尤其针对语义分割等密集预测任务。集成方法虽能提供强不确定性量化，但计算和内存开销大，难以实用；单模型近似方法又往往在效率与不确定性质量之间权衡取舍。

Method: ST-LoRA框架从单一训练轨迹中构建多样化集成成员：各成员共享冻结的预训练骨干网络，仅通过轻量级低秩适配器（LoRA）区分彼此，结合快照集成（snapshot ensembling）策略。通过消融实验发现，对于密集预测任务，前馈层而非注意力层是LoRA的关键适配目标，这与语言模型中仅关注注意力层的惯例不同。

Result: 在两个农业数据集（GrowliFlower-L花椰菜开放田和BUP20甜椒温室）及两种架构（SegFormer和Mask2Former）上，ST-LoRA在分割精度和校准方面匹配或超越全秩集成，同时大幅减少训练时间、推理延迟、内存占用和存储需求。与Snapshot Ensemble、MC Dropout和Deep Deterministic Uncertainty等高效基线相比，ST-LoRA在图像/像素级分布外检测、分布偏移下校准稳定性和跨种子方差方面一致匹配或更优，且参数和计算量显著更少。

Conclusion: LoRA高效的集成适配是面向不确定性感知的农业视觉系统的一种高度有效且实用的方法，证明了参数量不到全模型10%的轻量级集成框架能够在密集预测任务中实现全秩集成的性能水平。

Abstract: Reliable decision-support in digital agriculture requires accurate predictions and well-calibrated uncertainty estimates, particularly for dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation. Ensemble methods provide strong uncertainty quantification, but their computational and memory demands limit practical use, while single-model approximations often trade off uncertainty quality for efficiency. We propose ST-LoRA, a parameter-efficient ensemble framework that builds diverse ensemble members from a single training trajectory by combining Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) with snapshot ensembling. Each member shares a frozen pretrained backbone and differs only in lightweight low-rank adapters, reducing trainable parameters to under 10% of the full model while preserving ensemble diversity. We evaluate across two agricultural datasets - GrowliFlower-L (cauliflower, open field) and BUP20 (sweet pepper, glasshouse) - using SegFormer and Mask2Former, covering in-distribution performance, calibration under distribution shift, and out-of-distribution detection. Ablations show feed-forward layers, not attention layers, are the critical LoRA target for dense prediction, contrary to the attention-only convention from language models. ST-LoRA matches or exceeds full-rank ensembles in segmentation accuracy and calibration across both datasets and architectures, while substantially reducing training time, inference latency, memory footprint, and storage requirements. Against efficient baselines - Snapshot Ensemble, MC Dropout, and Deep Deterministic Uncertainty - ST-LoRA consistently matches or outperforms them in image/pixel-level OoD detection, calibration stability under shift, and cross-seed variance, with far fewer parameters and lower compute. These results show LoRA-efficient ensemble adaptation is a highly effective, practical approach for uncertainty-aware agricultural vision systems.

</details>


### [149] [Recursive Vision Language Models for General Symbolic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01534)
*Omid Nejati Manzari,Guillaume Lajoie,Hassan Rivaz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出R-Qwen，一个基于预训练Qwen骨干的递归推理框架，通过程序化自递归和深度监督反复精炼候选解，结合递归模型的结构化迭代计算与预训练LLM的语言和推理先验，在八个挑战性基准上超越现有递归推理模型和更大规模的LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 困难的符号推理任务（如数独、迷宫寻路和ARC）对LLM仍具挑战性，因为其固定深度的自回归推理限制了系统性的搜索、精炼和回溯能力。虽然递归模型（如HRM和TRM）通过迭代隐状态精炼解决了这一局限性，但它们通常针对特定任务设计，且未利用预训练语言先验。

Method: R-Qwen基于预训练Qwen骨干构建，通过程序化自递归和深度监督反复精炼候选解，将递归模型的结构化迭代计算与预训练LLM的语言和推理先验相结合。此外，将层次监督加权（HSW）适配到自回归模型中，通过跨递归步骤的指数加权损失来降低梯度方差并加速收敛。

Result: 在八个挑战性基准上，R-Qwen持续优于现有递归推理模型和显著更大的LLM，同时使用相当数量的可训练参数。在ARC-AGI数据集上实现了27.6%的基线改进，证明了递归精炼对通用符号推理的有效性。

Conclusion: 递归推理机制与预训练语言模型先验是互补的方法，能够协同提升符号谜题求解能力，为结合递归计算与预训练LLM优势提供了有效路径。

Abstract: Hard symbolic-reasoning tasks such as Sudoku, maze pathfinding, and ARC remain challenging for LLMs due to their fixed-depth autoregressive reasoning, which limits systematic search, refinement, and backtracking.
