<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学影像深度学习模型对所有输入施加固定计算量，未考虑病例难度差异。解剖引导的双流架构虽能提升诊断性能，但无条件地对所有病例同时评估两条流，即使单流已能高置信度解决的情况也浪费计算资源。需要一个能根据病例难度自适应分配计算资源的机制。

Method: 提出SecondOpinion框架：(1) 一个快速主流处理每个病例；(2) GateKeeper，一个被显式训练为二元正确性分类器的门控机制，判断主流预测是否需要额外审查；(3) 当被激活时，两条流通过轻量级交叉注意力融合模块结合。门控信号以"正确性"为监督目标，而非依赖无监督的置信度估计。

Result: 在统一五类胸片数据集和骨盆骨折数据集（含CT确认但X射线不可见的骨折子集）上，SecondOpinion达到或超越先前SOTA性能；解剖引导流仅在9.23%的胸片病例、24.12%的可见骨折和45.71%的不可见骨折上被激活，激活率直接反映任务难度。

Conclusion: 以正确性监督门控信号而非依赖无监督置信度，能使模型将解剖推理精确分配到真正需要的病例上，实现计算效率与诊断性能的平衡。

Abstract: Deep learning models for medical image analysis typically apply a fixed amount of computation to every input, regardless of case difficulty. Anatomy-guided dual-stream architectures have been shown to improve diagnostic performance, but they evaluate both streams unconditionally, even on cases a single stream could already resolve confidently. We propose SecondOpinion, a framework in which a fast primary stream processes every case, while a second, anatomy-guided stream is invoked only when GateKeeper, a gating mechanism trained explicitly as a binary correctness classifier, judges that the primary stream's prediction needs additional scrutiny, much as a clinician might seek a second opinion on a difficult case. When activated, the two streams are combined through a lightweight cross-attention fusion module. We evaluate SecondOpinion on a unified five-class chest X-ray dataset and a pelvic fracture dataset, the latter including a held-out, harder subset of fractures that are invisible on X-ray but confirmed via CT. SecondOpinion matches or exceeds prior state-of-the-art performance on both tasks, while activating its anatomy-guided stream on only 9.23% of chest X-ray cases, rising to 24.12% on visible fractures and 45.71% on invisible fractures, an activation rate that tracks task difficulty directly. These results suggest that supervising a gating signal toward correctness, rather than relying on unsupervised confidence, allows a model to allocate anatomical reasoning where it is actually needed.

</details>


### [184] [DAVET: Denoising-Aware Visual Evidence Trajectory Allocation for Diffusion Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01821)
*Yongkang Zhou,Xiang Xia,Cheng Yan,Fan Xu,Wuyang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DAVET框架，一种无需训练的视觉证据自适应分配方法，根据扩散去噪过程中的生成状态动态分配视觉证据，在LLaDA-V和LaViDa两个dVLMs上实现1.55倍加速，平均性能仅下降1.86%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散视觉语言模型（dVLMs）在去噪每一步都需要视觉条件输入，导致视觉条件化成为显著的重复推理开销。与自回归解码不同，扩散生成会反复回顾整个响应，而视觉证据的需求随去噪步骤而变化。现有加速方法要么通过解码端策略，要么通过视觉token压缩（剪枝或合并），但未将视觉证据视为一种需求随扩散过程演变的资源。

Method: DAVET是一种训练免费的框架，包含三个关键组件：1) 基于阶段条件的证据轨迹（phase-conditioned evidence trajectory）作为初始分配方案；2) 分配策略利用操作需求（operation demand）设定证据储备（evidence reserve），并通过轨迹风险（trajectory risk）调制每个去噪步骤的视觉证据分配；3) 通过从单一视觉编码构建的证据视图层次结构（hierarchy of evidence views）来实现分配预算，将"何时需要多少证据"与"证据视图如何构建"解耦。

Result: 在LLaDA-V和LaViDa两个代表性dVLMs及多个视觉理解基准上评估，DAVET实现平均1.55倍加速，平均相对性能下降仅为1.86%。

Conclusion: 去噪感知的视觉证据分配能够显著降低视觉条件化成本，同时基本保持生成质量，验证了将视觉证据视为随扩散过程演变的动态资源这一研究方向的可行性。

Abstract: Diffusion vision-language models (dVLMs) iteratively denoise masked responses while conditioning each denoising step on visual evidence, making visual conditioning a substantial recurring inference cost. Unlike autoregressive decoding, diffusion generation repeatedly revisits the entire response as uncertainty evolves. Our analysis reveals that visual evidence demand is strongly step-dependent, motivating adaptive allocation across denoising steps. Existing inference acceleration methods operate through decoding-side strategies or visual token compression via pruning and merging, but do not explicitly treat visual evidence as a resource whose demand evolves across the diffusion process. Therefore, we present Denoising-Aware Visual Evidence Trajectory Allocation (DAVET), a training-free framework that allocates visual evidence according to the evolving generation state. Starting from a phase-conditioned evidence trajectory, the proposed allocation policy uses operation demand to set an evidence reserve whose allocation at each denoising step is modulated by trajectory risk. DAVET realizes the resulting budgets through a hierarchy of evidence views constructed from a single visual encoding, separating when and how much evidence is needed from how the evidence views are constructed. Evaluated on two representative dVLMs, LLaDA-V and LaViDa, across multiple visual-understanding benchmarks, DAVET achieves an average speedup of 1.55$\times$ with an average relative performance drop of 1.86\%, showing that denoising-aware visual evidence allocation can reduce visual conditioning cost while largely preserving generation quality.

</details>


### [185] [Detail Continuation over a Trustworthy Coarse Scale for Autoregressive Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01823)
*Hongyi Fang,Jiahui Wu,Yichen Yue,Benjia Zhou,Dan Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出K2N方法，将视觉自回归（VAR）超分辨率从全路径生成重构为k到N的细节延续过程：早期粗尺度状态直接从LR输入建立，仅剩余细尺度通过自回归恢复，从而减轻幻觉问题并在幻觉导向评估中展现优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式超分辨率（GSR）中幻觉问题持续存在，现有VAR-based SR方法仍沿用完整的1到N自回归生成路径。然而对于超分辨率任务，LR中的粗尺度信息通常更可靠，而长自回归链可能累积预测误差。作者希望显式地利用尺度级生成接口，避免不必要的全路径生成。

Method: 将VAR-based SR从全路径生成重构为k到N的细节延续过程：前k个粗尺度状态直接从LR输入直接建立，仅剩余N-k个细尺度通过自回归方式恢复，从而将生成重点放在真正不确定的细节部分。

Result: K2N在标准SR指标上与VARSR基线保持竞争力，同时在幻觉导向评估中展现出更明显的优势，表明该方法能有效减少生成结果中的幻觉现象。

Conclusion: 显式地以尺度级方式重新思考VAR生成路径是提升生成式超分辨率可靠性的一个有前景的方向，代码将开源。

Abstract: Hallucination remains a persistent challenge in generative super-resolution (GSR), where reconstructed results may contain visually plausible yet weakly supported content, structural deviations, or unnatural textures with respect to the low-resolution (LR) input. Existing GSR methods have extensively explored the trade-off between perceptual realism and reconstruction fidelity, but the division between preserving reliable coarse-scale information and restoring more uncertain fine details is often handled implicitly within the overall restoration process. Visual autoregressive (VAR) modeling provides a natural opportunity to revisit this issue, as its coarse-to-fine next-scale prediction offers an explicit scale-wise generation interface. However, existing VAR-based SR methods still inherit the original full 1-to-$N$ autoregressive generation path, even though, for super-resolution, coarse-scale information in LR is often relatively more reliable, while long autoregressive chains may accumulate prediction errors. Motivated by these observations, we propose \textbf{K2N}, which reformulates VAR-based SR from full-path generation into a $k$-to-$N$ detail continuation process. Specifically, early coarse-scale states are established directly from LR, while only the remaining finer scales are restored autoregressively. Experimental results show that K2N remains competitive with the VARSR baseline on standard SR metrics, while exhibiting clearer advantages on hallucination-focused evaluation. These findings suggest that explicitly rethinking the generation path in a scale-wise manner can be a promising direction for improving the reliability of generative super-resolution. Our code will be released soon at https://github.com/BRL-SYSU/K2NSR.

</details>


### [186] [PartMat: Material-Aware 3D Part Decomposition with a Single Global Latent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01825)
*Guangming Fu,Jin Song,Yiyun Fei,Guoqiu Li,Ruigao Yang,Jianan Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PartMat，一个高效的材料感知3D部件分解与生成管道。它利用单一全局潜变量表示多部件几何，通过PartVAE在单次前向传播中解码所有材料部件，将推理成本与部件数量解耦；结合扩散模型和强化学习进行部件生成与材料分配/重叠抑制；最后用稀疏体素流匹配模型恢复细粒度几何细节。实验证明其在材料感知分解精度上显著优于现有方法，且推理高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有部件级3D生成方法存在两个关键局限：(1) 通常按功能语义而非实际应用（如室内设计）所需的可编辑材质边界（如布料、木材、金属）进行物体分解；(2) 部件独立生成导致计算成本随部件数量线性增长。这些问题限制了3D资产生成在结构化、可编辑和高效性方面的实际应用。

Method: PartMat包含三个核心组件：(1) PartVAE：学习统一的多部件几何表示，用单个全局潜变量表示所有部件，并通过单次前向传播解码全部部件，使推理成本与部件数量解耦；(2) 基于此表示的扩散模型：训练用于部件生成，并通过强化学习精炼以实现准确的材质分配和部件重叠抑制；(3) 稀疏体素流匹配模型：配备部件注意力机制，用于几何后处理以恢复细粒度几何细节。输入为参考图像和单个整体物体几何，输出按材质边界分解的多个部件。

Result: 大量实验表明，PartMat在材料感知分解精度上显著优于现有基线方法，几何质量与现有方法相当，同时保持高效推理性能（推理成本不随部件数量增长）。

Conclusion: PartMat通过全局潜变量统一表示、单次前向解码和强化学习优化，实现了高效且材质感知的3D部件分解与生成，为结构化可编辑3D资产生成提供了更实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Part-level 3D generation has recently attracted increasing attention for producing structured and editable 3D assets. However, existing methods typically decompose objects according to functional semantics rather than the editable material boundaries (e.g., fabric, wood, metal) required in practical 3D applications such as interior design. Additionally, current methods often generate parts independently, causing computational costs to scale linearly with the part count. To address these limitations, we present PartMat, an efficient material-aware 3D part decomposition pipeline that represents multi-part geometry with a single global latent. Given a reference image and a single whole-object geometry, PartMat decomposes the object into parts that follow material boundaries. First, we propose PartVAE to learn such a unified representation and decode all material parts in a single forward pass, thereby decoupling inference cost from the number of parts. Second, with this representation, a diffusion model is trained for part generation and refined via reinforcement learning for accurate material assignment and overlap suppression. Finally, to recover fine-grained geometric details, we introduce a sparse-voxel flow-matching model with part attention for geometry post-processing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PartMat significantly outperforms existing baselines in material-aware decomposition accuracy and achieves comparable geometric quality, while maintaining efficient inference.

</details>


### [187] [DeepVoyager-VL: Incentivizing Vision-in-the-Loop Search for Long-Horizon Multimodal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01827)
*Huanyao Zhang,Jiepeng Zhou,Runhao Zhao,Yanzhe Shan,Jiaoyang Chen,Bowen Zhou,Bo Li,Fang Wang,Jialong Wu,Zhengwei Tao,Lang Mei,Xiaohan Yu,Liyan Liu,Chong Chen,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DeepVoyager-VL，一个长时程多模态深度搜索框架，通过将视觉信息纳入中间推理环节（vision-in-the-loop），构建多模态事件图驱动数据合成、设计主动视觉获取的智能体框架，并通过无需强化学习的微调在十个多模态搜索基准上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有MLLMs依赖静态参数知识，难以处理知识密集型和动态演化的开放世界问题。多模态深度搜索虽已从单轮事实检索演进到长时程多轮搜索，但现有方法仅将视觉限制在输入或答案阶段，忽视了其在中间推理过程中的作用，且缺乏针对长时程交互的设计，导致视觉证据难以驱动持续的检索过程，限制了交互深度和推理跨度。

Method: 1) 构建多模态事件图驱动数据合成，生成具有中间视觉依赖和长推理链的问题；2) 设计智能体框架，实现主动视觉获取和按需图像加载；3) 在合成数据上对模型进行微调，无需使用强化学习。

Result: 在十个多模态搜索基准上的大量实验证明了DeepVoyager-VL方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过将视觉证据纳入中间推理循环，DeepVoyager-VL有效突破了现有方法在长时程多模态搜索中的局限，提升了交互深度和推理能力。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced visual understanding and reasoning, yet their static parametric knowledge limits their ability to address knowledge-intensive and dynamically evolving open-world problems. To move beyond this limitation, multimodal deep search has emerged as a key direction for open-world information access, evolving from single-turn factual retrieval toward long-horizon, multi-turn search guided by visual evidence. However, existing methods typically confine vision to the input or answer stage, overlooking its role in intermediate reasoning, and lack designs tailored to long-horizon interaction. Consequently, visual evidence rarely drives continued retrieval, constraining both interaction depth and reasoning span. To address these limitations, we propose DeepVoyager-VL, a long-horizon multimodal deep-search framework for vision-in-the-loop search. Specifically, we construct a multimodal event graph to drive data synthesis, yielding problems with intermediate visual dependencies and long reasoning chains. We then design an agent framework for active visual acquisition and on-demand image loading. Finally, we fine-tune models on the synthesized data without reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments across ten multimodal search benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

</details>


### [188] [MoCRA: Mixture of Compositional Rank-1 Atoms for 4K All-in-One Video Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01829)
*Yongcong Wang,Pu Wang,Hingchin Chen,Runci Bai,Yucheng Xin,Chen Wu,Chengchao Shen,Guangwei Gao,Siyuan Yao,Pengwen Dai,Zhuoran Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MoCRA，一个无需退化标签、支持原生4K输出且播放稳定的统一视频恢复模型。其核心发现是：雾和低光在降采样下仍可恢复，而雨和噪声仅在原生尺度存在，据此构建"频带匹配组合条件化"机制。MoCRA仅3.6M参数，一次训练同时处理雾、雨、噪声和低光四项任务，在4K上恢复速度超过所有基线（<0.5秒），效果最佳且无需光流估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实视频恢复同时面临三大挑战：无退化标签、原生4K输出、播放稳定性。现有方法分别解决这些问题但在联合场景下失效——逐帧退化感知在帧间翻转、降采样代理丢失雨和噪声、密集时间配准不适用于4K内存限制。此外，没有任何配对基准数据集能构成这一联合问题，因此需要先构建数据集再发展对应方法。

Method: 1) 构建UHV-4K-AIO数据集：在100个4K干净视频上物理建模雾、雨、传感器噪声和低光，并共享深度和运动信息。2) 观察到关键分裂：雾和低光在强降采样下依然存在，而雨和噪声仅存在于原生尺度。3) 提出MoCRA架构：一个秩1原子字典按帧稀疏重组合，作为条件同时驱动每片段一次处理的粗分支和浅层原生分辨率精炼分支。4) 训练一次覆盖全部四项任务，参数仅3.6M，无需光流。

Result: MoCRA在四项任务的任务平均PSNR上超越11个重新训练的图像和视频基线；在不估计运动的情况下，扭曲误差达到基于光流视频模型的水平；原生4K恢复用不到0.5秒完成，而最快基线需1.7秒。

Conclusion: MoCRA证明通过将条件化容量、计算和监督分配到每个退化类型实际存在的频带上，可以用极小参数量的轻量模型同时满足无标签、原生4K和播放稳定三大需求，为联合视频恢复设立了新基准和方法范式。

Abstract: Real-world video arrives hazy, rainy, dark, or noisy, and a deployable restorer faces three demands at once: no degradation label, native 4K output, and stability in playback. Existing methods answer them separately and break on the joint problem, because per-frame degradation readings flip between frames, downsampled proxies erase the rain and noise they are meant to remove, and dense temporal alignment does not fit 4K memory. No paired benchmark even poses that problem, so we build one. UHV-4K-AIO renders physically modeled haze, rain, sensor noise, and low light over the same 100 clean 4K clips with shared depth and motion, and its construction exposes the split MoCRA is built on: haze and low light survive aggressive downsampling, while rain and noise exist only at native scale. Band-matched compositional conditioning follows, spending conditioning capacity, computation, and supervision in the band where each degradation lives. One dictionary of rank-1 atoms, recomposed sparsely per frame, conditions both a once-per-clip coarse branch and a shallow native-resolution refiner, in 3.6M parameters and with no optical flow. Trained once for all four tasks, MoCRA takes the best task-mean PSNR of eleven retrained image and video baselines, holds warping error at the level of the flow-based video models while never estimating motion, and restores native 4K in under half a second, against 1.7 seconds for the fastest baseline.

</details>


### [189] [Decoupling semantics from vision: A framework for faithful visual-text compression evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01848)
*Yonghan Gao,Zehong Chen,Lijian Xu,Jingzhi Chen,Jingwei Guan,Xingyu Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文指出现有视觉-文本压缩（VTC）评估协议过度依赖下游任务性能，无法准确衡量文本保留效果。为此提出一个解耦MLLM能力的评估框架，并引入ZeroSense基准以确保测试样本低语义相关性，使评估结果纯粹反映VTC质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VTC方法（如DeepSeek-OCR）在长上下文建模中展示高压缩比，但现有评估协议依赖下游任务表现，由于MLLM固有的语言先验，这类指标无法准确衡量文本保留程度，导致对VTC质量的评估存在偏差。

Method: 提出一个解耦评估框架，将MLLM能力与VTC质量分离；在该框架内构建ZeroSense基准，通过降低测试样本的语义相关性（eliminating textual dependencies）确保评估结果纯粹反映VTC质量，不受下游模型语义推理能力干扰。

Result: 在多个数据集上的广泛实验表明，VTC质量与下游任务准确率之间存在显著分歧，验证了解耦评估框架的必要性。

Conclusion: 现有下游任务评估方法无法可靠衡量VTC质量，需要解耦的评估框架来忠实评估文本保留效果，ZeroSense基准为此提供了有效手段。

Abstract: Recent visual-text compression (VTC) methods, typified by DeepSeek-OCR, report impressive high token compression ratios for long-context modeling tasks by leveraging text-to-image rendering. However, existing evaluation protocols heavily rely on downstream task performance. Such evaluation metrics fail to accurately measure text preservation due to the strong inherent linguistic priors of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). In this work, we introduce a new evaluation framework that decouples MLLMs' capabilities to faithfully assess VTC quality. Within this framework, we further introduce the ZeroSense Benchmark to ensure low semantic correlation of testing samples. By eliminating textual dependencies, our benchmark guarantees that the evaluation results are purely reflective of VTC quality, unaffected by the semantic inference capabilities of downstream models. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that VTC quality and downstream task accuracy diverge significantly, highlighting the necessity of our decoupled evaluation framework.

</details>


### [190] [Transformer Geometry Observatory TGO-III: Semantic Geometry Observatory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01876)
*Kaustubh Kapil,Kishor P. Upla*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TGO-III框架，通过多种互补的观测工具（线性探针精度、Fisher比率、类质心距离、局部本征维度和局部PCA秩）系统分析ViT-Small/16在训练过程中逐层表征的语义几何和类可分性演化，验证了语义扩展假说。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管Vision Transformer已被广泛采用，但现有研究大多聚焦于token几何和训练动态，对表征协方差结构的演化和类级几何组织的研究相对不足。作者旨在填补这一空白，深入理解类级语义组织和类可分性如何随网络层与训练过程演化。

Method: 构建Transformer几何观测台第三版（TGO-III）框架，采用五种互补的观测手段：线性探针精度（Linear Probe Accuracy）衡量线性可分性、Fisher比率量化类间判别性、类质心距离评估类间分离程度、局部本征维度（LID）和局部PCA秩刻画表征流形的几何复杂度，对ViT-Small/16逐层表征进行系统分析。

Result: 实验发现：类表征随网络加深逐渐变得更加线性可分，Fisher判别性增强，类质心彼此远离，局部表征流形表现出依赖类别的结构化几何复杂度。这些结果为语义扩展假说提供了实证支持。

Conclusion: TGO-III将流形几何、协方差演化和语义组织之间建立了直接联系，拓展了Transformer几何观测台框架，表明训练过程中流形扩展伴随着表征向日益判别性的语义结构的渐进组织。

Abstract: With the widespread adoption of Vision Transformers in modern AI, the need to analyze their inherent representational behavior has become increasingly important. While most existing studies emphasize token geometries and training dynamics, the evolution of representational covariance structures and class-level geometric organization remains comparatively underexplored. In this work, we investigate semantic geometry and class separability as representations evolve across the layers of ViT-Small/16 through TGO-III: Semantic Geometry Observatory. It is a framework designed to analyze the emergence of semantic organization, feature evolution, and class-wise representation geometry throughout training. The framework employs multiple complementary observatories, including Linear Probe Accuracy, Fisher Ratio, Class Centroid Distances, Local Intrinsic Dimension, and Local PCA Rank, to quantify the progressive evolution of discriminative representations. Our analysis reveals that class representations become progressively more linearly separable, Fisher discriminability increases, class centroids move farther apart, and local representation manifolds exhibit structured class-dependent geometric complexity. These observations provide empirical evidence supporting the Semantic Expansion Hypothesis, suggesting that the manifold expansion observed in previous observatories is accompanied by the progressive organization of representations into increasingly discriminative semantic structures. Collectively, TGO-III extends the Transformer Geometry Observatory framework by establishing a direct connection between manifold geometry, covariance evolution, and semantic organization during Transformer training.

</details>


### [191] [Beyond Illumination: A Conditional Mutual Information-Guided Network for Low-Light Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01886)
*Ya-nan Guan,Shaonan Zhang,Tao Dai,Tianqu Zhuang,Yongchao Qiao,Zhensen Chen,Shu-Tao Xia,Hang Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CMIG-Net，利用条件互信息作为度量标准，通过CMIC模块和D2IR模块实现低光图像增强中色度与强度分支间的双向信息交互，在多个基准上超越CIDNet。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低光图像增强方法（如CIDNet）采用双分支架构分别建模色度和强度信息，但忽略了两个分量之间的相互交互，限制了表征能力，导致增强性能次优。

Method: CMIG-Net包含两个核心模块：(1) 条件互信息校准（CMIC）模块，生成条件信息图，根据局部照明统计对色度表征进行区域自适应重校准；(2) 动态双分支信息恢复（D2IR）模块，由条件先验和即时恢复状态共同引导，自适应控制强度与色度分支之间的双向信息流。

Result: 在成对的低光图像增强基准上，CMIG-Net一致优于CIDNet，PSNR最多提升0.619 dB；在具有挑战性的Sony-Total-Dark数据集上实现0.382 dB的提升。

Conclusion: 通过引入条件互信息作为原则性度量，量化色度特征在给定强度信息条件下的贡献，并设计双模块实现区域自适应校准和动态双向信息流控制，显著提升了低光图像增强的性能。

Abstract: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) seeks to restore structural fidelity, natural color rendition, and proper exposure from images captured under inadequate lighting conditions. Recent state-of-the-art approaches, such as CIDNet, adopt a dual-branch architecture comprising a chrominance (HV) branch and an intensity (I) branch to separately model decoupled chromatic and luminance information within the HVI color space. However, these methods overlook the mutual interaction between intensity and chrominance components, which inherently limits their representational capacity and leads to suboptimal enhancement performance. To address this limitation, we propose the Conditional Mutual Information-Guided Network (CMIG-Net), which leverages conditional mutual information as a principled metric to quantitatively assess the contribution of chrominance features conditioned on the available intensity information. In particular, we design a Conditional Mutual Information Calibration (CMIC) module that generates a conditional information map, enabling region-adaptive recalibration of chrominance representations according to local illumination statistics. Furthermore, we introduce a Dynamic Dual-branch Information Restoration (D2IR) module, which adaptively governs bidirectional information flow between the intensity and chrominance branches, guided by both the conditional prior and the instantaneous restoration state. Extensive experiments on paired LLIE benchmarks demonstrate that CMIG-Net consistently outperforms CIDNet, achieving up to a 0.619 dB gain in PSNR, with a 0.382 dB improvement specifically on the challenging Sony-Total-Dark dataset.

</details>


### [192] [GeoCore-9B: Towards Geo-Aware Generative Foundation Models in Earth Observation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01896)
*Jeonghyeok Do,Munchurl Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoCore-9B是一个90亿参数的生成式基础模型，首次从零开始在纯地球观测（EO）数据上训练。它基于Flow Matching的扩散Transformer架构，原生支持文本描述和连续地理空间元数据（地面采样距离、经纬度）的条件生成。通过提出的地理空间语义对齐损失从冻结的专家教师网络中蒸馏地表先验，在Git-10M全球数据集上预训练，在云去除和SAR到光学跨模态翻译等实际EO任务中取得新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的EO生成模型大多依赖对自然图像先验的微调，这限制了可扩展性，且引入与地理空间约束相冲突的视角偏差。作者希望构建一个专门为EO数据从头训练的大规模生成模型，以克服上述局限。

Method: GeoCore-9B采用基于Flow Matching的扩散Transformer（DiT）架构，从零开始在纯EO数据上训练。模型原生支持以文本描述和连续地理空间元数据（GSD、纬度、经度）为条件。针对该规模训练中的收敛和空间方向迷失问题，提出地理空间语义对齐损失，从冻结的专家教师网络中蒸馏地表结构先验（如地形和城市区域），在训练期间约束扩散潜在轨迹且不增加推理开销。

Result: 在Git-10M全球数据集上预训练后，GeoCore-9B在标准代理生成任务以及实际EO应用中（包括极具挑战性的云去除和SAR到光学跨模态翻译）均展现了强大的下游适应性。广泛评估表明其在视觉保真度和地理结构准确性两方面均达到新的SOTA水平。

Conclusion: GeoCore-9B证明了规模化的EO专用生成基础模型的可行性，通过从零训练、地理空间条件生成和语义对齐训练策略，克服了自然图像先验方法的局限，为EO生成式AI建立了新的性能基准。

Abstract: Existing generative models for earth observation (EO) predominantly rely on fine-tuning natural image priors, which limits their scalability and introduces perspective biases that conflict with geospatial constraints. To address this, we introduce GeoCore-9B, a 9-billion-parameter generative foundation model, which is the first of its scale to be trained from scratch exclusively on EO data. Unlike previous EO foundation models, GeoCore-9B is built upon a Flow Matching-based Diffusion Transformer (DiT) and natively conditions generation on text descriptions and continuous geospatial metadata, including ground sample distances, latitudes, and longitudes. To overcome the convergence and spatial disorientation challenges of training at this scale, we propose a Geospatial Semantic Alignment loss. This objective distills structural Earth surface priors (e.g., terrain and urban areas) from a frozen specialist teacher network, constraining the diffusion latent trajectory during training without adding inference overhead. Pre-trained on the global-scale Git-10M dataset, GeoCore-9B demonstrates strong downstream versatility. Beyond standard proxy generative tasks, we show that GeoCore-9B can be effectively adapted for practical EO applications, including highly challenging tasks such as cloud removal and SAR-to-optical cross-modal translation. Extensive evaluations confirm that GeoCore-9B establishes new state-of-the-art performance in both visual fidelity and geographic structural accuracy.

</details>


### [193] [SpatioLM: Towards General Physical Spatial Intelligence in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01899)
*Jing Wu,Jianhua Wu,Jiayi Guan,Jiahong Chen,Jinghui Lu,Hangjun Ye,Bingzhao Gao,Long Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpatioLM是一个参数高效的视觉语言模型，通过即插即用的空间视觉模块来激发VLM内在的空间知识，无需额外3D先验输入或外部空间编码器，在VSI-Bench上达到71.6分（首个突破70的模型），同时有效限制通用能力的退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在常识推理任务上表现良好，但在视觉空间推理方面较弱。现有解决方案要么引入额外的3D先验输入，要么依赖外部空间编码器，这些方法增加了系统复杂度，且空间微调后会损害VLM的通用能力。

Method: 提出即插即用且非侵入式的spatio-vision模块来激发VLM固有的空间知识；创新性地利用伪深度和相机信息作为监督信号，引导模型学习物理上连贯的表示；采用参数高效的方式设计整个框架。

Result: 在空间感知和理解等多类任务上取得显著提升，同时有效限制通用能力退化。在VSI-Bench上达到71.6分（首个突破70的模型），并在迁移到具身操作任务时也取得有竞争力的表现。

Conclusion: SpatioLM证明无需额外3D先验或外部编码器即可通过参数高效的方式增强VLM的空间智能，并在保持通用能力的同时实现先进的视觉空间推理性能。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well on commonsense reasoning tasks but struggle with visual spatial reasoning. Most existing solutions introduce extra 3D prior inputs or external spatial encoders, which increase complexity and degrade the underlying VLMs' general-purpose capabilities after spatial fine-tuning. To this end, we propose a parameter-efficient \textit{\textbf{Spatio}-vision \textbf{L}anguage \textbf{M}odels (SpatioLM)}, that enhances spatial intelligence without extra 3D prior inputs or third-party spatial encoders. Concretely, we design a plug-and-play and non-invasive spatio-vision module that elicits the spatial knowledge inherent in VLMs. Furthermore, we innovatively leverage pseudo depth and camera information as supervision to guide the model in learning physically coherent representations. Extensive experiments show that SpatioLM achieves significant improvements in diverse tasks, including spatial perception and understanding while effectively limiting the degradation of general capabilities. Notably, the model achieves an impressive score of 71.6 on the VSI-Bench (the first model to surpass 70). In addition, it attains competitive performance when transferred to embodied manipulation tasks. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/xiaomi-research/spatio-lm}{\faGithub~spatio-lm}.

</details>


### [194] [PhotoHOI: Synthesizing 3D Hand-Object Interactions from a Single RGB Photograph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01905)
*Zhenhao Zhang,Jiajun Zhang,Wei Min,Yebin Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhotoHOI是一个从单张RGB照片和开放词汇语言指令合成3D手物交互序列的新框架，通过视觉语言模型解析任务、恢复场景几何、规划碰撞感知轨迹，并利用可迁移的先验知识生成手部运动，在GRAB和H2O数据集上优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手物交互（HOI）合成方法通常需要预定义物体几何、物体轨迹或任务特定条件，限制了其在真实世界自然输入下的应用。作者希望解决从单张照片和自然语言指令这一更实用的输入形式出发合成3D HOI序列的问题。

Method: PhotoHOI采用两阶段流水线：(1) 使用视觉语言模型将输入图像和指令解析为结构化任务规格（交互物体、目标区域、空间关系）；(2) 恢复任务相关的紧凑3D场景，并基于物体状态、支撑关系和周围场景几何规划平滑的碰撞感知物体轨迹。为合成可泛化的手部运动，学习可迁移的任务条件接触先验和接触条件抓取先验（来自大规模affordance和HOI数据），并在学习到的潜在空间中优化抓取姿态，将优化约束在合理的手部流形上。

Result: 在GRAB和H2O数据集上的实验表明，方法在接触质量和穿透减少方面优于代表性基线；在真实世界照片上的结果展示了更高的任务成功率和场景一致性，并能泛化到未见物体和开放词汇指令。

Conclusion: PhotoHOI证明了从单张RGB照片和开放词汇语言指令合成3D手物交互序列的可行性，通过结构化任务解析、场景恢复和可迁移先验学习实现了对真实世界输入的良好泛化，为AR/VR、数字人类和具身交互等应用提供了实用基础。

Abstract: Hand-object interaction (HOI) is a fundamental human behavior with broad applications in AR/VR, digital humans, and embodied interaction. Existing methods typically require predefined object geometry, object trajectories, or task-specific conditions, limiting their use with natural real-world inputs. To address this, we study a more practical problem of synthesizing 3D hand-object interaction sequences from a single RGB photograph and an open-vocabulary language instruction, and introduce PhotoHOI. PhotoHOI first uses a vision-language model to parse the input image and instruction into a structured task specification, including the interaction object, target region, and spatial relation. It then recovers a compact task-relevant 3D scene and plans a smooth collision-aware object trajectory based on the recovered object states, support relations, and surrounding scene geometry. To synthesize hand motion that generalizes to real-world photographs and unseen objects, it learns transferable task-conditioned contact and contact-conditioned grasp priors from large-scale affordance and HOI data. The grasp is further refined in a learned latent space, constraining the optimization to a plausible hand-pose manifold. Experiments on GRAB and H2O demonstrate improved contact quality and reduced penetration over representative baselines. Results on real-world photographs further demonstrate higher task success and scene consistency, together with generalization to unseen objects and open-vocabulary instructions.

</details>


### [195] [Assessing the Benefits of Combining Advanced Deep Learning Techniques for Post-Disaster Building Damage Assessment from UAV Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01906)
*Huy Quang Ung,Guillaume Habault,Roberto Legaspi,Hao Niu,Lian Cao,Masato Taya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个混合框架，将CV模型的精确检测能力与LVLM的推理能力解耦结合：先由CV模型检测建筑物并生成边界框，再由LVLM进行损伤分类和上下文解释。在RescueNet和FloodNet两个基准上，该框架在评估建筑完好、部分损坏和完全摧毁状态上超越了独立基线最多2.1个R²点，且只需有限的标注数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾后建筑损伤评估至关重要但具有挑战性：CV模型需要大量标注数据、跨区域泛化能力差且局限于单一任务；LVLM具备较强推理和泛化能力但在精确的低层感知任务（如目标检测和边界框生成）上表现不足，且领域微调需要大量数据。现有单一模型难以同时满足精度与推理能力的需求。

Method: 提出一个解耦检测与损伤评估的混合框架：第一阶段由CV模型（检测器）在UAV图像上检测建筑物并生成边界框；第二阶段将边界框区域传递给LVLM进行损伤分类和上下文语义解释。该设计无需对LVLM进行大规模领域微调，仅需有限的标注数据用于检测阶段。

Result: 在两个真实世界基准（RescueNet和FloodNet）上进行评估。最佳模型组合在准确统计完好、部分损坏和完全摧毁建筑数量方面，比独立基线提高最多2.1个R²点。此外，论文还提供了失败场景和边缘案例的详细分析。

Conclusion: 混合框架有效结合了CV模型的检测精度与LVLM的推理能力，在有限标注数据条件下实现了优于独立基线的灾后建筑损伤评估性能。论文公开了源代码和数据，并为实际应用和未来工作提供了实用洞见。

Abstract: Rapid and accurate post-disaster building damage assessment is essential, yet remains a challenging task. Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) imagery offers a timely and high-resolution view of affected areas, but existing Computer Vision (CV) models often demand large annotated datasets, generalize poorly across geographic regions and their assessment policies, and are confined to the specific tasks they were trained for. Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) offer a promising alternative through their strong reasoning and generalization capabilities, but fall short on precise, low-level perception tasks such as object detection and accurate bounding box generation. Furthermore, they often require a substantial amount of data for effective fine-tuning on domain-specific tasks. In this paper, we propose a hybrid framework that decouples detection from damage assessment, combining the precision of CV models with the reasoning power of LVLMs. A CV model first detects buildings and generates bounding boxes on the image that are then passed to an LVLM for damage classification and contextual interpretation. We evaluated our framework on two real-world benchmarks: RescueNet and FloodNet. In particular, the best combination under this framework accurately counts intact, partially damaged and completely destroyed buildings, surpassing isolated baselines by up to 2.1 R^2 points, while requiring only limited annotated data for the detection stage. Beyond reporting aggregate gains, we provide a detailed analysis of failure scenarios and edge cases, offering practical insights for practitioners and concrete directions for future work. Our source code and data are publicly available to the research community via the following repository: https://github.com/ungquanghuy-kddi/VLM_GDINO.git

</details>


### [196] [PNEC-Mamba: Prototype-Guided Positive-Negative Evidence Calibration for Hyperspectral Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01910)
*Mingzhen Xu,Can Xu,Di Wang,Haonan Guo,Bo Du*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PNEC-Mamba，一种原型引导的正负证据校准框架，用于高光谱图像分类，通过分离类相关证据与干扰、估计像素级可靠性并进行选择性校准来提升分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实高光谱场景中像素表示往往因光谱相似性、混合像素和局部上下文干扰而具有模糊性，现有方法专注于学习更强表示或建模更广上下文，但很少研究学习到的表示是否提供可靠证据或引入干扰。作者希望从像素级证据可靠性建模角度解决分类决策中的干扰问题。

Method: PNEC-Mamba框架包含四个核心步骤：(1)全图像状态空间编码器提取像素表示，动态类原型与其联合演化提供语义参考；(2)从像素-原型竞争中推导正负证据，显式分离支持分类的判别线索与竞争类相关的混淆信号；(3)基于证据关系引入多源不确定性估计策略评估像素级可靠性，对不确定区域进行更强的证据校准；(4)应用全分辨率一致性细化步骤恢复局部空间细节并改善边界一致性。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，PNEC-Mamba相比最先进方法取得了更优的分类性能。

Conclusion: 通过原型引导的正负证据校准，PNEC-Mamba能够有效处理像素级证据不可靠问题，在区分判别性信息与干扰的同时增强不确定区域的校准，从而提升高光谱图像分类精度。

Abstract: In real-world hyperspectral scenes, pixel representations are often ambiguous due to factors such as spectral similarity, mixed pixels, and local context interference, which may simultaneously encode discriminative evidence and interfering information. Existing methods mainly focus on learning more powerful representations or modeling broader contexts, but rarely investigate whether the learned representations provide reliable evidence or introduce interference into classification decisions. To address this issue, we view hyperspectral image classification from the perspective of pixel-level evidence reliability modeling and propose PNEC-Mamba, a prototype-guided positive-negative evidence calibration framework. The framework progressively establishes semantic references, separates class-related evidence from interference, estimates pixel-level reliability, and performs selective calibration. First, a full-image state-space encoder extracts pixel representations, while dynamic class prototypes provide semantic references that evolve jointly with the feature space. Subsequently, positive and negative evidence is derived from pixel-prototype competition, explicitly separating discriminative cues that support classification from confusing signals associated with competing classes. Based on these evidence relationships, a multi-source uncertainty estimation strategy is introduced to assess pixel-level reliability, enabling stronger evidence calibration for uncertain regions. Finally, a full-resolution consistency refinement step is applied to recover local spatial details and improve boundary coherence in the final predictions. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that PNEC-Mamba achieves superior classification performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [197] [CHOW-SLAM: Compact Hybrid Representation with Complementary Overlap Window Optimization for RGB-D SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01914)
*Wenxuan Ji,Jin Xiao,Xiaoguang Hu,Jiaqi Shi,Zichong Jia,Baochang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CHOW-SLAM是一个基于NeRF的密集RGB-D SLAM框架，通过显式构建互补的空间约束（P-H混合表示）和时间约束（重叠窗口策略）来同时实现高质量场景重建和精确相机跟踪，在多个数据集上超越现有最先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于NeRF的SLAM系统在有限的在线计算资源下，难以同时构建两类约束：由场景表示产生的紧凑且具有判别性的空间约束，以及由历史观测产生的持久时间约束。这一挑战限制了系统在重建质量和跟踪精度上的表现。

Method: 提出CHOW-SLAM框架，包含：(1)空间上采用紧凑的参数化哈希(P-H)混合表示，基于平面和网格跨尺度组织P和H分支组件，并通过统一的多输出解码器对齐TSDF与密度诱导的光线终止分布；(2)时间上提出互补重叠窗口策略，在固定预算内保留近期帧、选择高重叠局部帧、引入时间分布的历史关键帧，防止优化被短期重叠或弱相关历史观测主导；(3)采用损失感知的关键帧插入和束调整调度以适应跟踪质量；(4)使用ORB特征跟踪和几何位姿估计进行位姿初始化，再通过神经渲染优化提高跟踪稳定性。

Result: 在多个数据集上的广泛评估表明，CHOW-SLAM在场景重建质量和相机跟踪精度方面均优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: CHOW-SLAM通过显式解耦并互补构建空间与时间约束，有效解决了在线资源受限下NeRF-SLAM系统难以同时兼顾紧凑场景表示和历史观测持久性的问题，在重建与跟踪两方面均取得优越性能，并已开源代码。

Abstract: Simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) based on Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) enables dense, continuous scene reconstruction. However, existing systems operating with limited online resources struggle to simultaneously construct two types of constraints, namely, compact yet discriminative spatial constraints derived from scene representations and persistent temporal constraints derived from historical observations. To address this challenge, we propose CHOW-SLAM, a dense RGB-D SLAM framework that explicitly constructs these complementary spatial and temporal constraints. Spatially, we propose a compact parametric-hash (P-H) hybrid representation that organizes components based on planes and grids across scales in P and H branches. A unified multi-output decoder further aligns the ray termination distributions induced by TSDF and density, preserving geometry and appearance under a compact parameter budget. Temporally, we propose a complementary overlap-window strategy to prevent optimization from being dominated by short-term overlap or weakly related historical observations. Within a fixed budget, the strategy retains recent frames, selects high-overlap local frames, and introduces temporally distributed historical keyframes. Loss-aware keyframe insertion and bundle adjustment scheduling further adapt optimization to tracking quality. In addition, ORB-based tracking and geometric pose estimation are used for pose initialization, followed by neural rendering optimization to improve tracking stability. Extensive evaluations on multiple datasets demonstrate that CHOW-SLAM outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both scene reconstruction quality and camera tracking accuracy. The source code is available at https://github.com/jinjidexiaohuoban/CHOW-SLAM.

</details>


### [198] [Recompute or Reuse? Diagnosing and Mitigating Textual Shortcuts in VLM Self-Reflection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01930)
*Wenxiao Fan,Jingling Fu,Fang Li,Luohang Liu,Yu He,Lichen Ma,Zhiyang Yu,Weishan Bi,Junshi Huang,Yan Li,Gu Simiu,Kan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现视觉语言模型（VLM）在视觉证据变化时，先前思维链（CoT）中的证据性推理内容会形成一种"文本捷径"，与视觉重计算竞争并主导模型的行为。作者提出一种无需训练的干预方法FSAF（Fresh-State Attention Firewall），有效提升视觉更新率并降低对先前答案的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM被期望在视觉证据变化时修订推理，但现有研究将失败归因于视觉注意力不足或上下文惯性，未能明确模型究竟"复用"了什么而非从当前图像"重新计算"。作者旨在揭示先前思维链中的证据性内容如何作为文本捷径影响模型推理。

Method: 论文采用匹配反事实分析（matched counterfactual analysis）在16个VLM上验证证据性内容是先前CoT影响的最稳健载体。通过移除证据性内容、非证据上下文和最终答案跨度来比较偏好转移，并测试对证据重排序的影响。在此基础上提出FSAF干预，一种训练自由的注意力防火墙机制，隔离当前图像的前向计算与先前CoT。

Result: 证据性内容移除对答案偏好的转移效果强于长度匹配的非证据上下文和最终答案跨度；对证据重排序也会削弱先验控制。在答案修正后捷径仍可能保留残余影响。FSAF在5个VLM上将视觉更新率从35.28%提升至53.61%，并将先验答案率从39.22%降至3.67%。

Conclusion: 可靠的VLM自反思想化需要超越"重新看一遍"：新鲜的视觉重计算必须被保护，免受陈旧文本复用的干扰。文本捷径与视觉重计算的竞争是一个系统性行为模式，需要针对性的架构或推理级干预来缓解。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are expected to revise their reasoning when visual evidence changes. Failures to do so are often attributed to insufficient visual attention or contextual inertia, leaving unclear what models reuse instead of recomputing from the current image. We show that evidence-bearing reasoning in a prior chain of thought (CoT) can form a textual shortcut that competes behaviorally with visual recomputation. Across 16 VLMs, a matched counterfactual analysis identifies evidence-bearing content as the most robust carrier of prior-CoT influence. Removing this evidence-bearing content shifts answer preference more than removing length-matched non-evidence context or the final-answer span, with prior control weakening progressively as more stale evidence is removed. Reordering this evidence also weakens prior control, showing that its organization modulates shortcut strength. Beyond the immediate answer, the shortcut can retain residual influence after answer correction: weakening current-image support shifts preference back toward the prior answer, while repeated prior answers and reused premises arise mainly when the shortcut remains active. To limit this influence, we introduce Fresh-State Attention Firewall (FSAF), a training-free intervention that isolates fresh computation from the prior CoT. Across five VLMs, FSAF raises visual update rate from 35.28% to 53.61% and reduces prior-answer rate from 39.22% to 3.67%. Reliable VLM self-reflection therefore requires more than looking again: fresh visual recomputation must be protected from stale textual reuse.

</details>


### [199] [CultureVidBench: Benchmarking Cultural Understanding in Text-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01942)
*Xianjing Han,Yuhan Su,Yang Deng,Dong Ma,Wee Peng Tay,Bin Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CultureVidBench，一个评估文本到视频（T2V）生成模型文化理解能力的综合基准，包含1,000个精心设计的提示词，覆盖12个国家、6大洲、8个文化区域和14个文化维度（分为物质文化、社会实践与表演、仪式与典礼三大类）。通过人类用户研究和基于MLLM的自动评估，对七个代表性T2V模型在文化保真度、多模态文化渲染、语义遵从性和感知质量四个维度进行评测，发现现有模型在语义遵从和视觉质量上表现良好，但在捕捉细粒度文化细节（尤其是不发达地区、仪式和多模态文化线索）方面存在明显不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2V生成模型发展迅速，但对其在不同文化语境下的表现缺乏系统性评估。已有基准主要关注感知质量、物理合理性和文本-视频对齐，未直接评估生成视频是否准确捕捉特定文化的物体、动作、仪式、可见文本或音频线索。

Method: 构建CultureVidBench基准，包含1,000个提示词，覆盖12国/6大洲/8个文化区域/14个文化方面，按物质文化、社会实践与表演、仪式与典礼三大类组织。强调动态和多模态文化表征（社会互动、仪式流程、文化适宜的可见文本与音频），并通过人类用户研究和MLLM自动评估对七个T2V模型进行四维度评测。

Result: 当前T2V模型在语义遵从性和视觉质量方面表现较强，但普遍未能忠实捕捉细粒度文化细节，特别是在代表性不足的地区、仪式场景及多模态文化线索（如文本和音频）方面存在显著短板。

Conclusion: T2V生成模型的文化理解能力仍有较大提升空间，CultureVidBench为该方向提供了系统性评测框架，并揭示了模型在多模态文化渲染和细粒度文化保真度上的关键挑战。

Abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) generation models have advanced rapidly, yet their ability to represent diverse cultural contexts remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks mainly focus on perceptual quality, physical plausibility, and text-video alignment, but do not directly assess whether generated videos capture culturally specific objects, actions, rituals, visible text, or audio cues. We introduce CultureVidBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating cultural understanding in T2V generation. CultureVidBench contains 1,000 curated prompts covering 12 countries, 6 continents, 8 cultural regions, and 14 cultural aspects organized into three categories: material culture, social practice & performance, and ritual & ceremony. Designed specifically for video generation, CultureVidBench emphasizes dynamic and multimodal cultural representation, including social interactions, ritual procedure, and culturally appropriate visible text and audio. We evaluate seven representative T2V models through human user studies and MLLM-based automatic assessment across cultural faithfulness, multimodal cultural rendering, semantic adherence, and perceptual quality. Results show that although current models achieve strong semantic adherence and visual quality, they often fail to faithfully capture fine-grained cultural details, particularly for underrepresented regions, rituals, and multimodal cultural cues.

</details>


### [200] [UniMoCa: Unifying Motion and Camera Controls as Visual Proxies for Faithful Human Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01944)
*Liming Tan,Ye Chen,Hao Zhang,Lirong Qian,Feifei Li,Bingbing Ni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniMoCa是一个统一人类运动与相机控制的视频生成框架，通过将3D人体运动与相机轨迹转换为同一视觉空间下的"运动-相机视觉代理"（MCVP）表示，消除了异构控制接口导致的控制归因困难问题，在Wan2.2 I2V上实现了多项控制指标的显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成管线对运动控制使用视觉运动序列（骨架图、姿态图等），而对相机控制使用非视觉的相机嵌入，这种异构控制接口使模型难以正确归因运动与相机各自的贡献，且对相机估计误差敏感。多人物场景下的大幅身体运动、遮挡和动态相机进一步加剧了这一挑战。

Method: UniMoCa的核心是Motion-Camera Visual Proxy（MCVP），一种可共享的新型表示：从驱动视频中提取3D人体运动与相机轨迹，将其渲染为身份中性的视觉代理——即在恢复的相机轨迹下渲染时间对齐的人体几何，并叠加显式的相机轨迹标记。这样一来，运动与相机控制都被表示为可区分的视觉线索，从异构的视觉-参数混合控制统一为同质视觉控制。

Result: 作者构建了MCVP-Video数据集，覆盖复杂动作、多人交互和多样化相机轨迹。基于Wan2.2 I2V的实验表明，UniMoCa在人体运动控制、相机控制、时间一致性和相机感知鲁棒性方面均取得显著提升，且只引入极小的额外复杂度。

Conclusion: 将运动与相机控制统一到同一视觉空间可以消除异构控制接口带来的归因歧义，提升视频生成的联合推理与编辑能力，是该方向一个有前景的表示驱动方案。

Abstract: Controlling human motion and camera movement is essential for faithful human-oriented video generation, yet remains challenging in multi-person scenes with large body motions, occlusions, and dynamic cameras. Existing pipelines typically rely on visual motion sequences, such as skeleton maps, pose maps, or rendered body representations, for motion control, while using camera embeddings for camera control. Such heterogeneous control interfaces force video generation models to reconcile pixel-aligned visual cues with non-visual geometric embeddings, making motion-camera attribution difficult and sensitive to camera estimation errors. We propose \textbf{UniMoCa}, a representation-driven framework that unifies motion and camera controls in visual space. At the core of UniMoCa is \textbf{Motion-Camera Visual Proxy} (\textbf{MCVP}), a mutually-sharable novel representation that converts 3D human motion and camera trajectories extracted from driving videos into an identity-neutral visual proxy. MCVP renders temporally aligned human geometry under the recovered camera trajectory and augments it with explicit camera trajectory markers, replacing heterogeneous visual-parametric controls with distinguishable visual cues. As both control factors are represented in the same visual space, they become mutually compatible rather than heterogeneous, enabling consistent joint reasoning and editing during video generation. We further curate a \textbf{MCVP-Video} dataset covering complex actions, multi-person interactions, and diverse camera trajectories. Experiments based on the Wan2.2 I2V show that UniMoCa achieves substantial gains in human motion control, camera control, temporal consistency, and camera-aware robustness with minimal additional complexity. More details are shown in our Project page: https://tanliming-daniel.github.io/UniMoCa/.

</details>


### [201] [Event ActivityNet: A Large-Scale Simulated-Event Benchmark for Untrimmed Action Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01948)
*Cheng-Yao Hong,Ting-Wei Lin,Yun-Chung Lai,Hua-Wei Lee,Hwann-Tzong Chen,Tyng-Luh Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Event ActivityNet，一个从ActivityNet视频生成的大规模模拟事件流基准，包含3,263个视频、200个动作类别和106.94小时，支持长时程事件流上的动作识别和在线时序定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程事件流动作理解尚未被充分探索，因为现有数据集多为短时裁剪片段，而采集带密集时序标注的原生事件流成本高昂。

Method: 从人工标注的非裁剪ActivityNet视频生成模拟事件流，提供5-bin和9-bin事件体素表示；保留帧率元数据用于时间映射；提出渐进式嵌套尺度训练协议和分阶段预训练策略。

Result: 识别Top-1准确率从52.25提升至66.42，在线时序定位平均mAP从21.7提升至29.0；分阶段Event ActivityNet预训练加原生事件微调在多种监督预算下均优于目标专用和从头联合训练。

Conclusion: Event ActivityNet为长时程事件建模提供了可扩展基准，但原生相机评估对部署相关结论仍至关重要。

Abstract: Long-horizon event-based action understanding remains underexplored because existing datasets largely comprise short, trimmed clips, while collecting native event streams with dense temporal annotations is costly. We introduce Event ActivityNet, a large-scale simulated-event benchmark derived from human-annotated, untrimmed ActivityNet videos. It comprises 3,263 videos, 200 action classes, and 106.94 hours, with matched 5-bin and 9-bin event-voxel representations, temporal action annotations, and timestamped captions. The benchmark supports annotated-segment action recognition, auxiliary event-language alignment, and causal online temporal action localization. We generate event voxels directly from non-interpolated source videos in decoded frame order, retain per-video rational nominal or average frame-rate metadata for approximate time mapping, and use action-center reconstruction LPIPS as a soft diagnostic of retained reconstructable content. We establish baselines for adaptive event framing, prompt-caption alignment, and event-only, RGB-only, and RGB-event localization. Under a progressive nested-scale training protocol, recognition Top-1 accuracy increases from 52.25 to 66.42, while online temporal localization average mAP improves from 21.7 to 29.0. Moreover, staged Event ActivityNet pretraining followed by native-event fine-tuning consistently outperforms target-only and joint-from-scratch training across multiple supervision budgets. Event ActivityNet provides a scalable benchmark for long-horizon event modeling, although native-camera evaluation remains essential for deployment-oriented conclusions.

</details>


### [202] [StyleForge: Indoor Furniture Styling by Counterfactual Reasoning in a Hypergraph Field](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01954)
*Lingwei Dang,Shishuo Shang,Pan Liu,Jiajia Cheng,Ziyan Qiu,Zhenhao Zhang,Yufei Zhu,Shenghui Huang,Qingxin Xiao,Yun Hao,Juntong Li,Qingyao Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StyleForge 是一个基于动态超图风格场的场景级结构化家具选择框架，用于固定布局室内家具风格搭配。它利用冻结的多模态大语言模型提取风格先验，通过动态超图风格场建模家具间高阶依赖，并结合反事实风格偏好学习评估每个候选项的上下文兼容性。在 3D-FRONT 数据集上取得了最先进的家具检索和场景级风格一致性结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法要么独立检索每个家具资产，要么依赖静态局部关系，导致场景组合后出现形状、材质和颜色冲突。固定布局家具风格搭配任务要求在不改变预定义家具类别、位置、朝向和尺度的前提下选择能形成整体风格协调房间的资产，这对场景级别的风格一致性提出了更高要求。

Method: StyleForge 框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 冻结的多模态大语言模型从开放式风格请求和固定布局中提取结构化风格先验；(2) 动态超图风格场，可自适应地激活和加权由布局引发的超边，捕捉家具间的高阶依赖关系；(3) 反事实风格偏好学习，将每个候选项视为当前风格场中的局部替换，使用马氏能量评估其上下文兼容性。训练阶段交替优化风格场和候选 logits；推理阶段冻结模型，仅通过测试时训练更新房间特定的候选 logits，随全局场景上下文变化逐步修正跨槽位风格冲突。

Result: 在 3D-FRONT 数据集上的实验表明，StyleForge 在家具检索和场景级风格一致性方面均达到最先进水平，相比对象级和场景级检索基线方法，能够生成更协调的固定布局家具布置。

Conclusion: StyleForge 通过将固定布局下的家具选择建模为场景级结构化选择问题，利用动态超图风格场捕捉高阶依赖关系并结合反事实偏好学习进行上下文兼容性评估，有效解决了固定布局家具风格搭配中跨槽位风格冲突的问题，验证了场景级建模在室内家具风格搭配任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Fixed-layout indoor furniture styling requires selecting assets that form a coherent room without changing the prescribed furniture categories, positions, orientations, or scales. Existing approaches typically retrieve each asset independently or rely on static local relations, making them prone to shape, material, and color conflicts after scene composition. We introduce StyleForge, a scene-level structured selection framework built on a dynamic hypergraph style field. A frozen multimodal large language model extracts structured style priors from an open-ended style request and the fixed layout, while StyleForge maintains a learnable candidate distribution for each furniture slot. Conditioned on the target style, the dynamic hypergraph style field adaptively activates and weights layout-induced hyperedges to capture higher-order dependencies among furniture. Counterfactual style preference learning then treats each candidate as a local substitution in the current style field and evaluates its contextual compatibility using Mahalanobis energies. Training alternates between optimizing the style field and the candidate logits. At inference, the model remains frozen and test-time training updates only room-specific candidate logits, progressively correcting cross-slot style conflicts as the global scene context evolves. Experiments on 3D-FRONT demonstrate state-of-the-art furniture retrieval and scene-level style coherence, producing more coherent fixed-layout furniture arrangements than object- and scene-level retrieval baselines.

</details>


### [203] [FAST-GS: Frequency Aware Space-time Gaussian Splatting for Photorealistic Dynamic Novel View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01958)
*Zhengyang Zhang,Ziyu Lu,PengCheng Li,Hongbo Duan,Yi Liu,Pengting Luo,Peiyu Zhuang,Xinghui Li,Shaohua Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于傅里叶运动建模的4D高斯泼溅方法，将运动分解为频率相关的正弦分量，分别捕捉低频全局轨迹和高频局部细节，并结合运动感知正则化策略抑制高频抖动，在复杂动态场景中显著提升了运动拟合精度和长期稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有4DGS方法使用单一多项式建模运动，在包含高频运动分量的复杂动态场景中性能受限，且因累积轨迹漂移无法保证长期稳定性。这两个核心缺陷驱动了本研究的开展。

Method: 提出傅里叶运动建模模块，将运动分解为基于频率的正弦分量以同时捕捉低频全局轨迹和高频局部细节；同时将运动感知正则化策略集成到损失函数中，利用频率相关权重抑制高频抖动并保持低频运动一致性。

Result: 在N3V和Google Immersive数据集上的多个场景进行了大量实验，验证了该方法在复杂运动拟合和长期一致性方面的有效性，同时保留了4DGS的实时渲染能力。

Conclusion: 该方法通过傅里叶频率分解替代单一多项式运动建模，有效解决了现有4DGS在复杂动态场景中高频运动拟合不足与长期轨迹漂移的问题，兼顾了实时渲染性能与运动建模精度。

Abstract: 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) excels in dynamic 3D reconstruction and real-time novel view synthesis via efficient 4D Gaussian representations and parallelizable rendering. However, existing 4DGS approaches rely on a single polynomial to model motion, which limits performance in complex dynamic scenes where high-frequency motion components are prevalent, and fails to ensure long-term stability due to cumulative trajectory drift. To address these issues, we propose a Fourier Motion Modeling module: this paradigm decomposes motion into frequency-based sinusoidal components, capturing both low-frequency global trajectories and high-frequency local details to model complex motion patterns accurately. It retains the real-time rendering capability of 4DGS while improving complex motion fitting and long-term coherence. Additionally, we integrate a motion-aware regularization strategy into the loss function: it uses frequency-dependent weights to suppress high-frequency jitter while preserving low-frequency motion coherence. Extensive experiments on N3V and Google Immersive datasets from multiple scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

</details>


### [204] [OSSDD - a New Open Dataset for Sentinel-1 Ship Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01963)
*Horst Hammer,Sylvia Hochstuhl,Antje Thiele,Tobias Brosch,Padraig Davidson,Tim Remiger,Michael Teutsch*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OSSDD，一个基于OpenSARShip 1.0构建的SAR图像船舶检测新数据集，包含15,197个Sentinel-1 VV和VH极化的幅度patch、二值船舶掩膜、轴对齐边界框和旋转边界框标注，共标注55,759艘船，并提供了三种检测器（Faster R-CNN、FCOS、DETR）的基准实验结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAR图像船舶检测对海上态势感知至关重要，但基于神经网络的现代检测方法需要大量训练数据，而SAR域的数据比电光域更加稀缺。现有免费数据集在可用性和质量上存在差异，因此需要构建一个新的高质量、可自由获取的SAR船舶检测数据集来支持相关研究。

Method: 基于公开的OpenSARShip 1.0数据集构建OSSDD，包含Sentinel-1卫星的VV和VH极化幅度patch，提供二值掩膜、轴对齐边界框（AABB）和旋转边界框（RBB）三种标注形式，并在数据集上训练了Faster R-CNN、FCOS和DETR三种常见检测模型，以建立基准。

Result: OSSDD共包含15,197个Sentinel-1幅度patch，覆盖VV和VH极化，标注了55,759艘船舶；三种检测器（Faster R-CNN、FCOS、DETR）的实验结果作为未来研究的基准。数据集已在Hugging Face平台免费公开提供。

Conclusion: OSSDD为SAR船舶检测提供了大规模、免费可用的数据集资源，通过提供多种标注形式和基准实验结果，填补了SAR域训练数据稀缺的空白，有助于推动SAR船舶检测领域的研究进展。

Abstract: Ship detection in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images plays an important role for maritime situational awareness, especially with respect to different illegal activities at sea such as illegal fishing, smuggling or border violations. Modern ship detection methods using neural networks usually require large training datasets, which are considerably scarcer in the SAR domain than in the electro-optical domain. While several free datasets exist for this task, their availability and usability vary. In this paper, OpenSARShip-Ship Detection Dataset (OSSDD), a new dataset based on the well-known OpenSARShip 1.0 dataset is proposed for training neural networks for SAR ship detection. OSSDD is freely available and contains 15,197 Sentinel-1 amplitude patches in VV and VH polarization, binary ship masks, axis-aligned bounding box and rotated bounding box annotations for a total of 55,759 ships. The construction of the dataset, the contents and structure of the downloadable data and experiments with three common detector models (Faster R-CNN, FCOS, DETR) are shown and discussed. The results serve as benchmarks for future experiments. The dataset is available on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/sylviaHoch/OpenSARShip-Ship-Detection-Dataset.

</details>


### [205] [LongHorizon-Harness: Advancing Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01964)
*Ziyu Ma,Hailang Huang,Shun Zou,Yong Wang,Shidong Yang,Yiming Hu,Fei Wei,XiangXiang Chu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LongHorizon-Harness，一种用于长时程LLM智能体的任务状态管理框架。它将任务状态显式化地维护在执行流程之外，通过"管理-执行-审计"（MEA）循环确保状态仅由环境中独立验证的事实进行更新，从而避免错误自我评估在决策链中传播，显著提升多个基准上的任务完成率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM智能体框架在处理长时程任务时，将任务执行、任务状态和完成度评估全部放在不断增长的上下文中，导致状态难以追踪，且智能体的错误自我评估会传播到后续决策中，造成错误累积和任务失败。

Method: 将长时程执行重定义为任务状态管理问题。提出的LongHorizon-Harness将任务状态显式地维护在执行过程之外，并仅用环境中独立验证过的事实来更新状态。其核心是管理-执行-审计（MEA）循环：管理器维护任务状态并决定下一个子任务；执行器在全新上下文中执行该子任务；只读审计器在下一轮之前验证产生的环境状态。此外，轻量级AgentAdapter支持可互换的模型和框架后端，无需修改其原生智能体循环。

Result: 在多个基准上取得显著提升：Qwen 3.7-Plus在WeaveBench上从51.8%提升至80.7%，在Terminal-Bench 2.1上从69.7%提升至77.2%，在OSWorld 2.0上从2.8%提升至8.3%；Claude Opus 4.7在OSWorld 2.0子集上从20.0%提升至34.3%，展示出跨模型、跨框架和跨交互领域的一致收益。

Conclusion: 通过将任务状态从执行上下文中解耦，并引入独立验证机制，LongHorizon-Harness有效解决了长时程任务中状态追踪困难和错误传播问题，为长时程LLM智能体提供了一种系统而通用的改进方案。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly undertake long-horizon tasks that require sustained reasoning, tool use, and revision across many interdependent steps. However, existing agent harnesses maintain task execution, task state, and completion assessment within a growing context, making the state difficult to track and allowing incorrect self-assessments to propagate into later decisions. We reformulate long-horizon execution as a task-state management problem and propose LongHorizon-Harness, which maintains the task state explicitly outside execution and updates it only with facts independently verified from the environment. Its Manage-Execute-Audit(MEA) loop uses a manager to maintain the task state and determine the next subtask, a fresh-context executor to perform it, and a read-only auditor to verify the resulting environment state before the next round. A lightweight AgentAdapter supports interchangeable model and harness backends without modifying their native agent loops. LongHorizon-Harness improves Qwen~3.7-Plus from 51.8% to 80.7% on WeaveBench, from 69.7% to 77.2% on Terminal-Bench~2.1, and from 2.8% to 8.3% on OSWorld~2.0. It also raises Claude Opus~4.7 from 20.0% to 34.3% on an OSWorld2.0 subset, demonstrating consistent gains across models, harnesses, and interaction domains.

</details>


### [206] [SVGEval: A Vision-Grounded Framework for Perceptual-Quality Benchmarking and Evaluation in Text-to-SVG Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01977)
*Yiming Wang,Ye Chen,Hanqi Chen,Bingbing Ni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SVGEval，一个视觉驱动的多模态基准，用于人类对齐的SVG质量评估，并基于此训练了一个可解释的SVG质量评分器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型越来越多地用于生成SVG，但可靠的评估方法仍未被充分探索。现有协议要么以代码为中心，要么借用光栅图像指标，无法反映人类感知，也忽略了SVG特定的几何和空间构图等质量要素。

Method: SVGEval显式纳入视觉渲染，评估模型是否能判断渲染结果而非仅检查SVG代码；通过多轮人工标注加专家精炼提供高质量标注；系统评估多种多模态模型，并基于基准训练一个可解释的SVG质量评分器，输出多方面的分数与文本理由。

Result: 系统性评估显示模型在语义对齐和美学方面表现相对较好，但在几何和布局相关判断上表现困难。消融实验表明显式视觉锚定和推理监督对空间和几何评估至关重要。

Conclusion: SVGEval为多模态模型时代的SVG生成提供了可靠的测试平台和实用的评分器，可用于评估和改进SVG生成。

Abstract: Multimodal large models are increasingly used to generate scalable vector graphics (SVG), but reliable evaluation remains underexplored. Existing protocols are often code-centric or borrow raster-image metrics after rendering SVGs, which fail to reflect human perception and overlook SVG-specific qualities such as geometry and spatial composition. We introduce SVGEval, a vision-grounded multimodal benchmark for human-aligned SVG quality assessment. SVGEval explicitly incorporates visual renderings to evaluate whether models can judge the rendered outcome rather than only inspect SVG code, and provides high-quality annotations obtained via multi-round human labeling with expert refinement. Systematic evaluations across representative multimodal models reveal a clear gap: models perform relatively well on semantic alignment and aesthetics, yet struggle on geometry- and layout-related judgments. Building on SVGEval, we train an explainable SVG quality scorer that outputs multi-aspect scores with textual rationales. Ablations show that explicit visual grounding and reasoning supervision are crucial, especially for spatial and geometric assessment. SVGEval offers a reliable testbed and practical scorer for evaluating and improving SVG generation in the era of multimodal models.

</details>


### [207] [Proxy Avatar Meets Low-Rank Caching: Real-Time One-Shot Emotion-Controllable Portrait Animation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01978)
*Haijie Yang,Jindi Bao,Yixuan Dong,Hongliang Zhang,Jian Bi,Hao Tang,Zhenyu Zhang,Jianjun Qian,Jian Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Proxy Avatar Meets Low-Rank Caching框架，通过高斯情感代理头像生成运动信号，结合大规模one-shot重定向模型和低秩缓存实现零样本外观复用，在保证情感表达力和身份保持的同时实现实时one-shot人像动画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的音频驱动人像动画方法在实时one-shot生成和表情控制方面仍面临挑战：缺乏足够的情感感知运动先验，多步去噪过程中外观计算开销高昂。

Method: 提出级联框架：(1) 高斯情感代理头像作为可复用运动生成器，单身份训练一次即可从音频和情感标签生成富有表现力的驱动视频；(2) 大规模one-shot重定向模型从代理表演中提取与身份无关的运动并适配任意目标人像；(3) 引入零样本外观复用与低秩缓存，在初始去噪步骤缓存参考外观特征，后续特征变化用轻量级低秩适配器建模。

Result: 实验表明该方法在情感表现力、身份保持动画方面表现更强，同时显著降低推理成本，实现实时one-shot人像动画。

Conclusion: 通过解耦运动生成与外观渲染、缓存复用外观特征的策略，成功克服了扩散模型实时推理的效率瓶颈，为情感可控的实时人像动画提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Audio-driven portrait animation has advanced rapidly with diffusion-based generative models, yet real-time one-shot generation with expressive emotion control remains challenging. Existing methods often suffer from insufficient emotion-aware motion priors and expensive appearance computation during multi-step denoising. To address these issues, we propose Proxy Avatar Meets Low-Rank Caching, a cascaded framework for real-time one-shot emotion-controllable portrait animation. Instead of directly generating the target portrait from audio, our method uses a Gaussian-based emotion proxy avatar as a reusable motion generator, which is trained once on a single identity to produce expressive driving videos from audio and emotion labels. Since the proxy avatar only provides motion rather than target appearance or geometry, a large-scale one-shot retargeting model further extracts identity-independent motion from the proxy performance and adapts it to arbitrary target portraits. To improve inference efficiency, we introduce zero-shot appearance reuse with low-rank caching, which caches reference appearance features at the initial denoising step and models subsequent feature variations using lightweight low-rank adapters. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves stronger emotional expressiveness, better identity-preserving animation, and substantially reduced inference cost, enabling real-time one-shot portrait animation.

</details>


### [208] [ET-Prune: Evidence-Aware Dynamic Budgeting for Visual Token Pruning in Text-Rich MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01979)
*Zizhong Ding,Junxian Li,Kai Liu,Shaoqiu Zhang,Xiao Xiao,Linghe Kong,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ET-Prune，一种无需训练的视觉Token剪枝框架，将剪枝视为证据分配过程，通过解码器侧的部分查询-键块获取问题相关的证据信息，保护文本类空间区域，并根据证据不确定性和密度生成样本特有的Token保留下限。在六个骨干-基准组合上以约一半Token达到了领先或持平的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视觉Token剪枝方法使用固定Token比例，与文本密集输入不匹配。在OCR-centric任务中，决定性的证据可能只是极少数标签或字段，不加区分地剪枝会抹掉关键证据，同时保留视觉显著但与任务无关的区域。

Method: ET-Prune包含四个关键组件：(1)从解码器侧部分查询-键块中推导问题条件化的证据；(2)保护文本类空间区域；(3)将证据不确定性和密度转化为样本特有的Token下限；(4)通过三个渐进式中间层事件将序列推向该预算——对稀疏或文本密集证据保留更多Token，对集中证据更激进地剪枝。整个流程在单一确定性前向传播中完成，无需训练。

Result: 在所有六个骨干-基准组合中，ET-Prune以约一半Token在剪枝方法中领先或持平。在OCRBench-v2上，分别超过最强剪枝基线1.80和0.68个百分点（Qwen3-VL-8B和InternVL3.5-8B），同时仅保留约一半视觉Token；在MMBench v1.1上达到0.8467的圆形精确匹配准确率（Vanilla为0.8437），平均视觉Token保留率为54.45%。

Conclusion: ET-Prune展示了在文本密集多模态推理中，证据感知的动态预算能够带来有利的观测质量-成本权衡，证明在OCR-centric场景下基于证据分配的自适应Token剪枝是优于固定比例剪枝的有效方案。

Abstract: Visual token pruning reduces the inference cost of multimodal large language models, but a fixed token ratio is poorly matched to text-rich inputs. In OCR-centric tasks, decisive evidence can be a small number, label, or field whose relevance is specified by the question; indiscriminate pruning can erase that evidence while retaining visually salient but irrelevant regions. We present ET-Prune, a training-free framework that casts pruning as evidence allocation. It derives question-conditioned evidence from a decoder-side partial query-key block, safeguards text-like spatial regions, and converts evidence uncertainty and density into a sample-specific token floor. Three progressive middle-layer events then move the sequence toward this budget, retaining more tokens for diffuse or text-dense evidence and pruning concentrated evidence more aggressively. At the observed point estimates from one deterministic pass per configuration, ET-Prune leads or ties among pruned methods in all six backbone-benchmark comparisons at roughly half tokens. On OCRBench-v2, it leads the strongest pruned baselines by 1.80 and 0.68 percentage points on Qwen3-VL-8B and InternVL3.5-8B, respectively, while retaining about half of the visual tokens; on MMBench v1.1, it reaches 0.8467 circular exact-matching accuracy versus 0.8437 for Vanilla at 54.45% average visual-token retention. These results show a favorable observed quality-cost trade-off for evidence-aware dynamic budgeting in text-rich multimodal inference.

</details>


### [209] [AdaThinkV: Adaptive Thinking for Token-Efficient Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01980)
*Jingqi Tian,Haoji Zhang,Lin Chen,Hongbo Jin,Haonan Xu,Tianrui Zhu,Xingming Shui,Shilin Ma,Wenjing Yang,Yansong Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AdaThinkV是一个用于视频推理的自适应思考框架，通过强化学习让视频多模态大语言模型根据问题难度自动决定是否进行显式推理，在无需离线难度标签、人工阈值或外部路由器的条件下，实现推理效率与准确率的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 链式思维（CoT）推理能提升困难视频问题的表现，但往往在简单问题上浪费解码token。论文希望研究视频多模态大语言模型能否针对每个问题自适应地调整其推理努力程度，以兼顾精度与效率。

Method: 提出AdaThinkV框架：在强化学习过程中为每个提示并行采样显式推理和直接回答两种模式的rollouts；引入ThinkGain估计显式推理在提示层面的效用（平衡准确率增益与额外响应长度），同时为条件响应生成和自主模式选择提供监督；提出方差恢复策略优化（VRPO），针对rollout探索受限导致奖励信号不足的困难提示，保留并逐步扩展这些组以恢复可学习信号；推理时在单个自回归序列中完成模式选择与响应生成。

Result: 在统一的视频推理评估套件上，AdaThinkV平均准确率达到40.79，平均仅使用257.20个输出token，相比最强自适应基线的准确率提升2.98个点，同时减少22.7%的token消耗。

Conclusion: AdaThinkV验证了视频多模态大语言模型可以通过自学习实现按问题难度自适应分配推理努力，在不依赖外部信号的前提下同时改善推理准确率和token效率。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can improve performance on difficult video questions but often wastes decoding tokens on simple ones. We study whether a video multimodal large language model can adapt its reasoning effort to each question. We propose AdaThinkV, an adaptive framework for video reasoning that learns whether to reason explicitly without offline difficulty labels, manually tuned confidence thresholds, or an external router. During reinforcement learning, AdaThinkV samples matched rollouts in explicit reasoning and direct answering modes for each prompt. ThinkGain estimates the prompt-level utility of explicit reasoning by balancing its accuracy gain against additional response length, providing supervision for both conditional response generation and autonomous mode selection. For difficult prompts, limited rollout exploration can yield groups in which every response is unsuccessful and accuracy rewards show little variation, providing insufficient signal for learning. We therefore introduce Variance Recovery Policy Optimization (VRPO), which retains and progressively expands these groups to recover informative signals from prompts that are difficult yet solvable. At inference, AdaThinkV selects a response mode and generates the response in a single autoregressive sequence. Across a unified suite of video reasoning evaluations, AdaThinkV achieves a mean accuracy of 40.79 with an average of 257.20 output tokens, outperforming the strongest evaluated adaptive baseline by 2.98 points while using 22.7% fewer tokens. Project page: https://trilarflagz.github.io/AdaThinkV/

</details>


### [210] [DiffPrune: differentiable information throttling for token pruning in vision-language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01985)
*Landi He,Mingde Yao,Shawn Young,Lijian Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiffPrune通过信息节流器（Information Throttler）为视觉token打分并实现高效剪枝，在保留96.5%精度的同时将LLM预填充加速2.85倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法依赖Gumbel-Softmax近似离散选择，导致token分数取决于松弛剪枝算子的行为，而非直接反映信息丢失的后果，训练不稳定且分数语义不明确。

Method: DiffPrune在训练时保留所有token，通过信息节流器向视觉token注入保持方差的噪声，根据分数削弱token信息：高分token保持接近原始表示，低分token携带较少原始信息。损失通过这条实际信息节流的路径反向传播，避免松弛token选择的非稳定替代路径。推理时移除节流器，使用学习到的分数进行硬top-K剪枝。

Result: 在十个VLM基准测试上，DiffPrune保留96.5%的完整模型准确率，LLM预填充加速2.85倍，推理开销仅为0.69毫秒。

Conclusion: DiffPrune通过将token分数与信息损失直接关联，为视觉token剪枝提供了更稳定且语义明确的训练方式，在精度保持与计算加速之间取得了良好平衡。

Abstract: Visual token pruning reduces the computational cost of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) by removing redundant visual tokens. The key is to learn a score that measures whether a token is useful. Existing methods typically rely on Gumbel-Softmax to approximate discrete selection during training. Such selectors make the score depend on the behavior of a relaxed pruning operator, not directly on the consequence of information loss. In this paper, we propose DiffPrune, which gives token scores a direct meaning. During training, DiffPrune keeps all tokens and weakens each token's information according to its score. If weakening a token hurts the task, the scorer is pushed to protect it; if not, the token can receive a lower score. Because the loss is differentiated through this actual information-throttling path, the scorer avoids the unstable surrogate path of relaxed token selection. DiffPrune implements this idea with an Information Throttler, which injects variance-preserving noise into visual tokens, where high-score tokens remain close to their original representations, while low-score tokens carry less original information. At inference, the throttler is removed, and hard top-K pruning is applied using the learned scores. Across ten VLM benchmarks, DiffPrune retains 96.5% of full-model accuracy while accelerating LLM prefill by 2.85x, with only 0.69 ms inference overhead. Code will be publicly available.

</details>


### [211] [Grounding and Explaining Visual Evidence for AI-Generated Image Detection in Human-Centric Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01988)
*Kun Guo,Yuzhou Yang,Haoyue Wang,Qichao Ying,Sheng Li,Zhenxing Qian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出HAVE数据集（40K真实+39K AI生成图像，106K局部化证据实例，覆盖8类证据）和PAVE框架（联合真实性预测、视觉证据定位和区域对齐解释生成），用于人工中心场景下可解释的AI生成图像检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测方法虽然能判断真伪，但解释与证据区域之间存在不一致，降低了解释的可靠性；同时现有基准对人类中心场景覆盖有限。

Method: PAVE框架包含三个联合任务：真实性预测、视觉证据定位和区域对齐解释生成。采用评判引导的对齐奖励（judge-guided alignment reward）来评估区域-解释一致性和证据有效性，并加入感知感知正则化（perception-aware regularization），通过对原图和随机掩码图像的token级预测对比来促进模型对视觉输入的依赖。

Result: 在HAVE数据集及外部数据集上的实验表明，PAVE在真实性检测、视觉证据定位和解释质量三个任务上均表现优异。

Conclusion: 通过联合优化检测与解释任务并引入对齐奖励和感知感知正则化，PAVE能够提供更一致、更可靠的可解释AI生成图像检测结果，HAVE数据集填补了人类中心场景基准的空白。

Abstract: Rapid advances in image generation models call for interpretable AI-generated image detection methods that not only determine authenticity but also provide supporting visual evidence. Existing approaches may produce inconsistencies between generated explanations and localized evidence regions, undermining the reliability of explanations for authenticity decisions. Meanwhile, existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of the diverse human-centric scenes prevalent in generated imagery. To address these limitations, we investigate authenticity detection with grounded and explainable visual evidence in human-centric scenes. We present HAVE (Human-centric AI-generated Visual Evidence), a diverse human-centric dataset comprising 40K real and 39K AI-generated images from 10 recent generators, with 106K localized evidence instances across 8 evidence categories, each annotated with a bounding box and a region-aligned explanation. We further propose PAVE, a Perception-Aware Visual Evidence framework that jointly performs authenticity prediction, visual evidence grounding, and region-aligned explanation generation. PAVE employs a judge-guided alignment reward to assess region--explanation consistency and evidence validity, together with perception-aware regularization that contrasts token-level predictions between original and randomly masked images to promote reliance on visual input. Experiments on HAVE and external datasets demonstrate strong performance in authenticity detection, visual evidence grounding, and explanation quality. Code and data will be released upon publication.

</details>


### [212] [SPARE: Structural Parameter-Free Affinity Regularization for Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01990)
*Zong-Wei Hong,Jinglun Li,Shen Zhang,Yuhan Liu,Linze Li,Yao Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SPARE（Structure-free Affinity Regularization），利用干净数据潜变量中token间的成对相似性作为正则化目标，无需外部编码器、投影头或额外参数，即可加速去噪扩散Transformer（DiT）的训练收敛。SPARE不仅匹配图像内部token的亲和度，还扩展至跨图像token对，在ImageNet 256×256上以SiT为骨干、400K迭代预算下，取得了参数无关正则化方法中最低的FID。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去噪扩散Transformer训练收敛慢，现有正则化方法分两类：基于目标的（target-based）方法需要外部编码器和可学习投影头来对齐外部特征，开销大；无目标（target-free）方法没有参考，只能排斥自身特征，丢弃数据内在结构。先前工作表明空间结构而非全局语义驱动了对齐收益，作者因此探索能否直接以空间结构作为目标，以及该结构是否不仅存在于图像内部还存在于跨图像之间。

Method: SPARE的核心洞察是：干净数据潜变量已经在token间的关系（即两个token的相似性，一个标量）中携带了空间结构，且该标量在无需投影头的情况下可在特征空间间直接比较。SPARE匹配中间token与干净潜变量的成对亲和度，并将匹配扩展至跨图像的token对（这正是无目标方法默认排斥的），用单一学习目标同时校准图像内和跨图像的两种关系类型。方法完全参数无关，不添加编码器、投影头或任何参数。

Result: 在ImageNet 256×256、SiT骨干、400K迭代预算下，SPARE不增加编码器、投影头或参数，仅增加0.08 GB训练内存，但在所有测试设置中取得了参数无关正则化方法中最低的FID，恢复了REPA的FID降低的37-54%，与REPA结合使用时可超越REPA单独效果，在1M迭代、分类器无关引导下达到FID 1.90。

Conclusion: 空间结构（token间亲和度）可以直接作为扩散Transformer正则化的目标，且该结构既存在于图像内部也存在于跨图像之间。SPARE证明了一种完全参数无关、无需外部编码器的正则化方式能够有效加速DiT训练收敛，且与现有基于目标的方法（如REPA）互补可进一步提升生成质量。

Abstract: Denoising diffusion transformers achieve strong generation quality but converge slowly during training. Regularizing their internal representations has emerged as an effective accelerator, yet existing methods split into two families with complementary costs. Target-based methods strengthen representations by aligning them to external features, which requires an external encoder and a learnable projection head to bridge feature spaces. Target-free methods hold no reference at all, and can only repel the model's own features across samples or layers, discarding whatever structure the data contains. Prior work suggests that spatial structure, rather than global semantics, drives the gains of alignment. We therefore ask whether such structure can serve as a target directly, and whether it exists not only within an image but across images. Our key insight is that the clean data latent already carries this structure in the relations among its tokens, where a relation is the similarity between two tokens, a single scalar comparable across feature spaces without a projection head. We propose Structural Parameter-free Affinity Regularization (SPARE), a regularizer that matches the pairwise affinities of intermediate tokens to those of the clean latents. To exploit this structure fully, SPARE extends the matching to token pairs across images, precisely the pairs that prior target-free methods repel by default, and calibrates both relation types with a single learning objective. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$ with SiT backbones under matched 400K-iteration budgets, SPARE adds no encoder, head, or parameters and only 0.08 GB of training memory, yet attains the lowest FID among parameter-free regularizers in every tested setting, recovers 37 to 54\% of REPA's FID reduction, and improves over REPA when combined with it, reaching FID 1.90 under classifier-free guidance at 1M iterations.

</details>


### [213] [ASTRA: Asynchronous Spatio-Temporal Reconstruction via Trajectory Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02006)
*Junyu Zhu,Hao Zhu,Xinzhuo Zhang,Hongdong Li,Zhan Ma,Xun Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ASTRA是一个利用2D运动轨迹作为显式、纹理无关监督信号的异步动态3D重建框架，通过轨迹对齐联合优化时间偏移和动态3D表示，解决了现有异步重建方法在大偏移和复杂运动下因纹理诱导塌缩和形变诱导耦合导致的时序估计失效问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有异步重建方法依赖光度监督来估计时间偏移，但在大时间偏移和复杂运动下，外观匹配提供的时序线索非常微弱。作者将其归因为两大瓶颈：1）纹理诱导塌缩——低纹理区域的配准信号几乎消失；2）形变诱导耦合——时间误差被吸收到扭曲的几何或运动中而非被显式纠正。这两个瓶颈导致现有方法鲁棒性差。

Method: ASTRA框架的核心创新在于引入2D运动轨迹作为显式、纹理无关的监督信号。具体做法包括：1）不再仅通过渲染颜色残差来同步相机，而是将重建3D点的投影运动与观测到的2D轨迹进行对齐，联合优化时间偏移和动态3D表示；2）使用动态和置信度掩码来抑制不可靠的轨迹约束；3）在多个动态高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splatting）骨架上进行验证。

Result: 在多种动态高斯泼溅骨架上，ASTRA在严重异步（最高25帧偏移）条件下仍能保持高频空间细节和强鲁棒性，PSNR提升约1.4 dB，时间偏移平均绝对误差（MAE）降低54.0%，同步成功率几乎翻了两番（提高约4倍）。

Conclusion: ASTRA通过引入2D轨迹对齐取代纯光度监督，有效解决了异步动态重建中纹理退化和大偏移下的时序估计难题，显著提升了异步重建的准确性和鲁棒性，为实际场景中的非同步多相机动态重建提供了更可靠的解决方案。

Abstract: Dynamic 3D scene reconstruction has achieved remarkable success under the assumption of strictly synchronized multi-camera inputs. However, in real-world scenarios, temporal asynchrony among capturing devices remains a critical challenge, leading to severe motion blur and geometric artifacts. Existing asynchronous reconstruction methods typically estimate temporal offsets through photometric supervision, but appearance matching provides weak temporal cues under large offsets and complex motions. We attribute this limitation to two major bottlenecks: texture-induced collapse, where low-texture regions provide nearly vanishing alignment signals, and deformation-induced coupling, where temporal errors are absorbed into distorted geometry or motion rather than being explicitly corrected. To address these issues, we propose ASTRA (Asynchronous Spatio-Temporal Reconstruction via Trajectory Alignment), a framework that introduces 2D motion trajectories as explicit, texture-agnostic supervision for asynchronous dynamic reconstruction. Instead of synchronizing cameras solely through rendered color residuals, ASTRA jointly optimizes temporal offsets and dynamic 3D representations by aligning the projected motion of reconstructed 3D points with observed 2D trajectories, while using dynamic and certainty masking to suppress unreliable trajectory constraints. Extensive experiments on different dynamic Gaussian Splatting backbones show that ASTRA preserves high-frequency spatial details and sustains strong robustness even under severe asynchrony with up to 25-frame offsets, achieving approximately 1.4 dB PSNR improvement, reducing temporal-offset MAE by 54.0\%, and nearly quadrupling the synchronization success rate.

</details>


### [214] [Beyond Global Latents: Chunk-Based Sparse Grid VAE for Scalable 3D Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02016)
*Kaiyi Zhang,Zhihao Liang,Haolin Liu,Qingxiang Lin,Zeqiang Lai,Yunfei Zhao,Bowen Zhang,Xianghui Yang,Zibo Zhao,Chunchao Guo,Long Quan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ChunkVAE，一种围绕局部块（chunk）而非全局隐空间组织的稀疏网格变分自编码器。通过局部学习算子、平衡二值对象分割和S曲线加权拼接等机制，ChunkVAE在512³到1536³分辨率下达到与强基线相当或更优的重建质量，同时降低峰值显存占用并加速并行推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏体素网格虽能保留三维重建所需的空间结构，但其内存随分辨率增长而迅速膨胀（活跃表面单元增多），限制了高分辨率下的可扩展性。

Method: 1) 将VAE组织为围绕局部块而非全局隐空间的结构，采用局部学习算子，允许编码器和解码器分区独立选择，推理块大小可与训练不同；2) 提出两种互补数据算子：平衡二值对象分割（Balanced Binary Object Partitioning）在分配活跃单元的同时限制复制重叠，以及S曲线加权拼接（S-Curve Weighted Stitching）在组装全局隐空间或重建时抑制不可靠的边界特征。

Result: 在三个物体基准上，ChunkVAE在512³至1536³分辨率下与强基线相当或更优；较小的块降低峰值显存分配并缩短逐块计算时间，实现更快的并行推理；稳定的拼接隐空间和改进的图像到3D指标表明局部压缩可以扩展几何规模，同时保留下游所需的全局接口。

Conclusion: 局部压缩策略能够在不牺牲全局接口的前提下实现几何规模扩展，ChunkVAE为高分辨率稀疏网格3D重建提供了兼顾效率与质量的可扩展方案。

Abstract: Sparse voxel grids preserve the spatial structure needed for detailed 3D reconstruction, but their memory still grows rapidly with resolution as active surface cells increase. We introduce ChunkVAE, a sparse grid variational autoencoder organized around local chunks rather than a global latent volume. Local learned operators permit independently chosen encoder and decoder partitions and allow inference chunk sizes to differ from training. Two complementary data operators make this flexibility practical: Balanced Binary Object Partitioning distributes active cells while limiting replicated overlap, while S-Curve weighted stitching attenuates unreliable boundary features when assembling a global latent or reconstruction. Across three object benchmarks, ChunkVAE is competitive with or better than strong baselines from $512^3$ to $1536^3$; smaller chunks lower peak allocated memory and shorten per-chunk compute, enabling faster parallel inference. Stable stitched latents and improved image to 3D metrics indicate that local compression can scale geometry while retaining the global interface required downstream.

</details>


### [215] [Invisible Ink Threats: Adversarial Goals Behind Legitimate Tasks in Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02018)
*Jia-Chen Zhang,Ze-Yu Zhang,Kai-Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"隐形墨水威胁"（Invisible Ink Threats）概念，指低危害的间接提示注入攻击因其行为与合法任务难以区分而能绕过CUAs的安全机制和人类监督。作者构建了II-Bench基准（444个示例，覆盖三平台、三类攻击）和HITLCUA测试框架（真实虚拟机+Docker隔离Web环境+API模拟用户审查），评估主流CUAs后发现低危害注入攻击可广泛绕过代理防御和模拟用户审查，暴露了当前CUAs中严重且此前未被充分探索的安全风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然人机协同（human-in-the-loop）防御能有效抵御高危害的提示注入攻击，但对"隐形墨水"类低危害注入目标（如给仓库加星标、安装软件包）几乎不提供保护，因为这些行为与合法任务执行在行为上难以区分，既能逃避模型安全机制也能逃避人类监督。作者旨在系统性地研究这一防御盲区。

Method: 作者构建了II-Bench，包含444个看似无害的对抗性任务示例，覆盖机密性和完整性攻击，涉及三个平台和三类攻击类别（页面导航与交互、敏感信息外泄、代码下载与执行），每类以自然语言和代码两种形式、两种指令具体级别实现。此外构建了HITLCUA测试框架，集成真实虚拟机操作系统环境与隔离的基于Docker的Web平台，并通过允许CUA在可疑操作前咨询API模拟用户来模拟人类参与。

Result: 对主流CUAs的广泛评估显示，低危害注入攻击频繁绕过代理防御和模拟用户审查，暴露了当前CUAs中严重且此前未被充分探索的安全风险。

Conclusion: 现有的人机协同防御范式无法有效应对低危害、行为上不可区分的注入攻击，需要开发专门针对"隐形墨水威胁"的新防御策略。

Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs), which empower large language models to autonomously operate operating systems and the web, are increasingly vulnerable to indirect prompt injection attacks. A widely adopted defense is the human-in-the-loop paradigm, in which the agent pauses for explicit user confirmation before executing sensitive operations.
